<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 4.25</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><B>KAMADA LTD.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><B>COMPENSATION POLICY FOR EXECUTIVE OFFICERS
AND DIRECTORS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">1.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">OBJECTIVES OF THE POLICY</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">This document is designed to determine,
describe and detail the policy of Kamada Ltd. (the &ldquo;<B>Company</B>&rdquo;) with respect to the compensation of the Company&rsquo;s
office holders, the amount of the compensation, its components and the method for determining compensation.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company&rsquo;s compensation policy
and its publication are designed to enhance the level of transparency of the Company&rsquo;s activities relating to the compensation
of office holders and to improve the ability of the shareholders to express their opinion and influence the Company&rsquo;s compensation
policy for officer and directors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">This document shall apply to the Company&rsquo;s
office holders: the chief executive officer, members of the Company&rsquo;s executive management, each person fulfilling such positions
even if his title is different, and directors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">This document does not grant any rights
whatsoever to an office holder. Each of the Company&rsquo;s office holders shall be entitled to compensation only in accordance with
his respective employment contract approved by the compensation committee, the board of directors (and the shareholders, to the
extent required).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">This document determines (among other things)
the maximum values for the various components of compensation. Awarding compensation to an office holder in an amount that is less
than the amounts specified in this document shall not be deemed to be a deviation from the provisions of this compensation policy
and shall not require the approval of the shareholders that is required by law in the event of deviation from the terms of the
compensation policy.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Except with respect to the terms of service
and employment of office holders that were approved prior to the date of approval of this compensation policy, any deviation or
exception from this compensation policy (excluding, as described above, awarding compensation which is less than the compensation
stated in this policy) shall be subject to the approval of the Company&rsquo;s compensation committee, board of directors and the
shareholders, to the extent required by law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1; Options: NewSection; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->1<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Amended and Restated Compensation Policy &ndash; Approved on December 24, 2019</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">This compensation policy shall apply to
the terms of service and employment of office holders that are approved following the date of approval of this compensation policy.
This compensation policy does not derogate from existing contractual obligations, as of the date of approval of this compensation
policy, between the Company and its office holders.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The policy is drafted in the masculine
solely for convenience and applies to both men and women, without distinction.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In this policy, the Company&rsquo;s &ldquo;competent
organizations&rdquo; are the compensation committee and the board of directors, and with respect to the compensation of the Company&rsquo;s
chief executive officer, directors and controlling shareholders, also the shareholders, to the extent required by law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">2.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">GENERAL BACKGROUND</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 39.4pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -21.55pt"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">2.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">PURPOSE OF THE COMPENSATION
POLICY FOR OFFICE HOLDERS</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">This compensation policy for
office holders is designed to assist in achieving the Company&rsquo;s objectives and work plans with a long-term view, taking into account,
among other things, the Company&rsquo;s risks management policy and to ensure that:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">2.1.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">The
interests of the Company&rsquo;s office holders shall be as close as possible to and aligned with those of the Company and the
shareholders;</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">2.1.2.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">The
Company may recruit and retain senior officers capable of leading the Company to further business success and able to handle future
challenges;</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">2.1.3.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">Office
holders shall have motivation to attain a high level of business achievements without taking unreasonable risks;</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">2.1.4.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">Office
holders shall be compensated for achieving the Company&rsquo;s strategic targets; and</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 39.4pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -21.55pt"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 2; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->2<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Amended and Restated Compensation Policy &ndash; Approved on December 24, 2019</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 39.4pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -21.55pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">2.1.5.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">An
appropriate balance shall be established between the various compensation components &ndash; fixed vs. variable compensation,
quantitative and measurable components vs. discretionary components, short-term vs. long-term components, compensation in cash
vs. equity-based compensation and benefits and perquisites.</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 39.4pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -21.55pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">2.2.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">PRIMARY BODIES INVOLVED
IN DETERMINING THE COMPENSATION POLICY FOR OFFICE HOLDERS</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 75.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The parties
involved in determining the Company&rsquo;s compensation policy are:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Compensation committee of the board of directors &ndash;
makes recommendations to the board of directors regarding the approval of the compensation policy for office holders and any extensions
and updates to the policy to the extent required; approves the terms of service and employment of office holders; and may determine
to exempt a transaction from shareholder approval (in the event that the compensation committee believes that bringing the transaction
to the approval of the shareholders could jeopardize an arrangement with a candidate for chief executive officer).</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Board of directors &ndash; approves the compensation
policy for office holders; periodically reviews the compensation policy and is responsible for updating it as and when necessary.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Shareholders &ndash; approves the compensation policy, to the extent approval is required by law.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">2.3.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">BUSINESS ENVIRONMENT
AND ITS IMPACT ON COMPENSATION OF OFFICE HOLDERS</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">As a Company engaged in the
development of biological based drugs (biopharmaceuticals), the Company competes with other companies in the same and related fields
to recruit and retain managers and leading professionals. As at the date of writing this document (July 2013), no shortage of highly
talented management personnel with expertise in the Company&rsquo;s specific field of business has been experienced; however, since it
is a growing area with several companies joining each year, the Company&rsquo;s management personnel could be a target for recruitment
by rival companies alongside a shortage which could develop over the following years.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 3; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->3<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Amended and Restated Compensation Policy &ndash; Approved on December 24, 2019</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The Company&rsquo;s compensation policy
was designed, among other things, to ensure the Company&rsquo;s ability to recruit and retain the highly talented management personnel
it requires to continue to develop its business and business success, all in accordance with and subject to the objectives of the
compensation policy set forth in Section 2.1, including the promotion of the Company&rsquo;s goals in the long-term.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">3.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">OFFICER&rsquo;S COMPENSATION IN VIEW OF COMPANY VALUES
AND BUSINESS STRATEGY</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 39.4pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -21.55pt"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">3.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">COMPENSATION ACCORDING
TO THE OFFICER&rsquo;S CHARACTERISTICS AND EXPERIENCE</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Officer compensation shall take
into account the officer&rsquo;s education, skills, expertise, professional experience and achievements, as well as the characteristics
of the position which he is intended to fulfill and the responsibilities of the position. It is clarified, however, that the foregoing
shall not constitute threshold conditions for purposes of fulfilling a specific position in the Company (because at times prior
experience in a position and the relevant field are equivalent to or prevail over formal education in the field), and all of the
foregoing characteristics shall be taken into account in the examination of the suitability of a candidate for a particular position.
Without derogating from the foregoing, an office&rsquo;s compensation shall be determined, for each of the various compensation
components, according to the foregoing parameters, the nature of the position and the areas of responsibility, while preserving
an appropriate balance between the various compensation components set out in this document.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">3.2.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">RATIO BETWEEN OFFICER
COMPENSATION AND COMPENSATION OF OTHER COMPANY EMPLOYEES</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The Company aims to compensate
its office holders for their contribution to its business success over time, taking into account the extensive responsibility and
authority imposed upon them.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 4; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->4<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Amended and Restated Compensation Policy &ndash; Approved on December 24, 2019</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Nevertheless, since the Company
employs a relatively small number of employees most of whom have unique professional expertise, the Company attaches importance
to the creation of appropriate compensation for all of its employees and in preserving reasonable gaps between the overall compensation
of officers and the compensation of the other Company employees.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The compensation committee and
the board of directors have examined the ratio between the terms of service and employment of officers and the average and median
salary of the other Company employees and contractors, and the ratio between the terms of service and employment of officers and
the average and median cost of employment of the other Company employees and contractors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The compensation committee and
the board of directors believe that the ratio is appropriate and reasonable taking into account the nature of the Company, its
size, value, scale of activity in the various fields, the mixture of manpower and its field of activity and that it does not adversely
impact labor relations within the Company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">3.3.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN
THE COMPANY&rsquo;S BUSINESS RESULTS AND OFFICER COMPENSATION</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The Company&rsquo;s policy is that
the overall compensation for officers should be considerably influenced by its business results as well as the individual contribution,
responsibility and professional expertise of each officer to the achievement of these results. The higher the management position,
the influence of the business results and the individual contribution to the achievement of these results on the executive&rsquo;s
compensation shall increase. For this purpose, the higher the management position, the weight of the variable compensation that
is performance based in relation to the overall compensation shall increase, all as specified in Section 4.2 below.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">4.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">PRIMARY CONCEPTS OF THE COMPENSATION POLICY</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 39.4pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -21.55pt"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">4.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">OVERALL COMPENSATION
CONCEPT</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The Company&rsquo;s compensation committee
and board of directors believe that the overall compensation of each employee and in particular of officers should be comprised
of a number of different components, such that each element rewards the employee for a different element of his contribution to
the Company, thus achieving the objectives of the Company&rsquo;s compensation policy:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Base salary &ndash; designed to partially reward the
employee for the time he devotes to the performance of his role and the daily performance of his tasks. The base salary takes
into account, on the one part, the employee&rsquo;s skills (such as experience, know-how, expertise accumulated in the field of
business, education, professional qualifications etc.) and, on the other part, the requirements of the role and the responsibility
and authority it carries.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 5; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->5<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Amended and Restated Compensation Policy &ndash; Approved on December 24, 2019</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Benefits and perquisites &ndash; some of which are
mandatory according to law (such as pension, severance pay, vacation days, sick leave, recuperation pay, etc.), some of which
are common market practice (such as health insurance, insurance for loss of earning capacity, further education funds, which have
certain tax benefits for the employee and the Company) and others are designed to compensate the employee for expenses incurred
in fulfilling the position (such as a company car, travel expenses, phone, etc.).</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Variable performance based awards (e.g. annual bonus)
&ndash; designed to reward the officer for his achievements and contribution to attaining the Company&rsquo;s goals during the
course of the period for which the variable compensation is paid and to supplement the base salary. The weight of variable performance
based compensation in relation to the overall compensation shall increase the higher the officer&rsquo;s management position.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Equity-based compensation &ndash; designed to link
long-term shareholder returns and the compensation of officers and employees of the Company. Equity-based compensation creates
a correlation between the interests of employees and officers and the interests of the Company&rsquo;s shareholders and assists
in creating motivation and in retaining the key personnel in the Company.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">The ratio required between the
components of an officer&rsquo;s compensation package is set forth in the following table<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 39.4pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -21.55pt"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">5.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">BASE SALARY</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.1.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Determination of the
base salary for officers</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">The
base salary for an officer shall be determined during the course of the negotiations for his employment in the Company, which shall
be conducted by the person who shall directly supervise the officer (for the chief executive officer &ndash; the chairman of the
board of directors or whoever is appointed on his behalf for such purpose, for a vice president &ndash; the Company&rsquo;s chief executive
officer or whoever is appointed on his behalf for such purpose). The officer&rsquo;s intended supervisor may determine the base
salary based on a range to be determined and approved in advance for such purpose in accordance with the provisions prescribed
in this policy. </FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">The
salary to be determined, within the foregoing range, shall express the skills of the candidate (including, among other things,
his education, professional experience and expertise) and his suitability to the intended position as well as also the acceptable
salary conditions in the relevant market and the Company&rsquo;s financial capability at the time of recruitment.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in"></P>

    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">The
Company believes that the emphasis of its compensation policy should be on performance based compensation and therefore, the Company&rsquo;s
policy is to determine a base salary which is close to the median salary in the relevant market for similar positions, alongside
variable performance based compensation and long-term compensation components that will bring the officer&rsquo;s overall compensation
to a level which will allow the Company to recruit and retain the highly talented management personnel it requires for continuation
of its success.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">Because
officers hold a management position within the meaning of the Hours of Work and Rest Law, such law shall not apply to officers
and they shall not be entitled to compensation for overtime work or work on the day of rest.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.75in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.1.1.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; background-color: white"><U>Market

similar positions in companies similar to the Company. For purposes of the foregoing comparative studies, companies meeting the
maximum number as possible of the following characteristics shall be selected:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">The <FONT STYLE="background-color: white">compensation</FONT>
of directors of the Company (including external directors and others) who are not <FONT STYLE="background-color: white">employed</FONT>
in another position in the Company shall be determined pursuant to the Companies Regulations (Rule Regarding the Compensation and
Expenses of an External Director), 5760 &ndash; 2000 (the &ldquo;<B>Compensation Regulations</B>&rdquo;) and shall not exceed the
maximum compensation permitted under the Compensation Regulations, among other things taking into account their definition as financial
experts.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">Compensation to directors who
are employed in another position in the Company shall be determined in accordance with the Company&rsquo;s customary compensation
for similar positions, subject to the provisions of this compensation policy.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">The Company may award directors
equity-based compensation pursuant to the provisions of Section 5.2.2 below, subject to the provisions of the Compensation Regulations.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">Directors shall be entitled only
to such compensation that has been expressly provided for in this document.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.1.2.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Periodical review and update of salary</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">In order to retain officers, the
officers&rsquo; base salary shall be reviewed annually during the course of the <FONT STYLE="background-color: white">first</FONT> quarter
of each year, taking into consideration the challenges of the given year and the following year, the complexity of the officers&rsquo;
roles, their scope and importance to the Company&rsquo;s performance, all based upon the Company&rsquo;s resources and in comparison to the
acceptable salary for similar roles in the relevant market. To the extent necessary, a proposal regarding an increase to all or
any of the officers&rsquo; salaries shall be prepared and brought before the Company&rsquo;s relevant organs for approval.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.1.2.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal"><U>Linkage</U></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The officers&rsquo;
salary shall not be linked to any index apart from the statutory cost of living increase.</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">5.2.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">VARIABLE COMPENSATION</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 75.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in">Variable
compensation components are intended to achieve several objectives:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">To link part of the officers&rsquo; compensation to
the achievement of business goals and targets which, in the long-term, bring maximum value to the Company and create a joint interest
between the officers, the Company and its shareholders.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Increase the officers&rsquo; motivation to attain the
Company&rsquo;s long-term goals.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Correlating some of the Company&rsquo;s payroll costs
with its performance and enhancing its financial and operational flexibility.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 57.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">5.2.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Annual bonus</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">The Company&rsquo;s officers shall be
entitled to an annual bonus, based upon the <FONT STYLE="background-color: white">annual</FONT> bonuses plan which shall be brought
before the compensation committee and the board of directors for approval.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.2.1.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal"><U>Principles</U></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">Annual</FONT>
bonuses for officers shall be calculated according to the annual bonus plan, to the extent it is approved by the Company&rsquo;s competent
organs. The annual bonus plan shall be <FONT STYLE="background-color: white">comprised</FONT> of the following provisions:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT>Payment thresholds based on one or more quantitative financial
measure(s) of Company performance during the year for which the bonus is paid (such as revenue, gross profit, EBITDA, operating
profit or net profit). The compensation committee shall determine the measure from the list and according to the Company&rsquo;s objectives
for the bonus year. In addition, the compensation committee shall determine a substitute measure which may be used as a payment
threshold according to the board of directors resolution during the course of the bonus year where, due to circumstances which
could not have been anticipated and which are not in the control of the Company&rsquo;s board of directors, the Company would not succeed
in meeting the primary threshold(s).</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT>Determining the target bonus for each officer &ndash; a target
bonus is the bonus paid when 100% of the targets have been met &ndash; in terms of a salary multiplier. A target bonus shall be

<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">The targets for each measure, for the bonus year.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.2.1.2.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal"><U>Determining the bonus plan measures and targets</U></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">Personal
targets and measures shall be determined for each officer, according to which the officer&rsquo;s performance shall be measured. A weight
shall be assigned to each measure for determining the annual bonus for each officer, and the bonus paid to the officer shall be
determined in accordance with the weighted percentage of meeting the targets, as described below. There shall be three main categories
of</FONT> performance measures for each officer:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT>Company measures &ndash; economic or strategic measures,
which may be measured quantitatively, in relation to the Company&rsquo;s performance (sales turnover, operating profit, percentage of
operating profit, EBITDA, net profit, obtaining approval from the authorities in the target markets, etc.). These measures shall
be the same for all Company officers and the extent of meeting their targets shall determine 80% of the total bonus for the Company&rsquo;s
chief executive officer and 40% of the total bonus for vice presidents.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->12<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Amended and Restated Compensation Policy &ndash; Approved on December 24, 2019</P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">Personal
measures &ndash; quantifiable and measurable key performance indicators (KPIs) shall be determined for each officer separately,
in accordance with his position. The extent of meeting these measures shall determine a further 40% of the total bonus of a vice
president. No personal measures shall be determined for the chief executive officer. </FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT>Managerial appraisal (the Company&rsquo;s chief executive officer
or the chairman of the board of directors, as the case may be) &ndash; an evaluation of each officer&rsquo;s performance in terms
that are not measurable but which have a contribution to the Company&rsquo;s long-term performance. The managerial appraisal shall determine
up to 20% of the officer&rsquo;s total bonus. At the beginning of each year, qualitative measures shall be determined on the basis of
which the appraisal of each officer shall be made.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">The
targets in the personal and managerial measures of each officer shall be </FONT>determined <FONT STYLE="background-color: white">in
accordance with the work plan targets for the bonus year.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.2.1.3.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal"><U>Determination of the bonus budget</U></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">The
total annual budget for the bonuses of Company&rsquo;s officers shall be determined according to the sum of the maximum bonuses of all
officers. After the Company has achieved a net profit for two consecutive years, a maximum total annual bonus budget shall be determined,
in terms of a percentage of the Company&rsquo;s operating profit (or the net profit/ gross profit / EBITDA / other measure or any combination
thereof, according to the resolution of the Company&rsquo;s compensation committee and board of directors), unless otherwise determined
in the Company&rsquo;s annual budget approved by the board of directors (e.g., if the Company has operating losses as a result
of an increase in research and development costs, partnerships or M&amp;A). In years where the Company does not meet the minimum
percentage of the target determined by the Company, as determined by the compensation committee from time to time, no bonuses shall
be paid to officers.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.2.1.4.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal"><U>Bonus calculation mechanism</U></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The bonus for
each officer shall be determined according to the extent that the officer has met the targets determined for him for the bonus
year. The weighted percentage of meeting the targets of each officer shall be translated into a bonus percentage according to the
&ldquo;payment line&rdquo; formula determined in the bonus plan for officers, which shall be multiplied by the target bonus (the
personal bonus) of the officer for the purpose of calculating the actual bonus. The maximum target bonus for vice presidents shall
be eight times the base monthly salary, for the deputy chief executive officer, nine times the base monthly salary and for the
chief executive officer, ten times the base monthly salary.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The &ldquo;payment
line&rdquo; shall determine:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 2in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The minimum percentage of meeting targets (the lower performance threshold) up to which the officer
shall not be paid any bonus whatsoever; the minimum percentage is 70%.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 2in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The percentage of the target bonus which shall be paid in achieving the lower performance threshold;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 2in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">A maximum percentage of the target bonus (the bonus ceiling) which shall be paid upon achieving
a considerably higher level of performance than the targets; the maximum percentage is 150% of the target bonus.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 2in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The level of performance where the personal bonus ceiling shall be paid.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->14<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Amended and Restated Compensation Policy &ndash; Approved on December 24, 2019</P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Calculation
of the target bonus percentage for each level of performance between the above-mentioned points shall be made by a linear method.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.2.1.5.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal"><U>The approval process for the actual bonus</U></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">At the end
of each year, the extent of meeting targets by each of the officers shall be calculated. The percentage of meeting targets of the
officer shall be translated into a percentage of the target bonus according to the payment line formula. The actual bonus to be
paid shall be calculated by multiplying the target bonus percentage by the target bonus.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The compensation
committee and the board of directors shall be entitled to reduce an officer&rsquo;s annual bonus at their discretion taking into account
the following factors:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The amount of the officer&rsquo;s contribution to the Company&rsquo;s business development beyond the specific
responsibility;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The quality and speed of the officer&rsquo;s response to crises and unanticipated events;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The officer&rsquo;s contribution to the promotion of the Company within his field of expertise or outside
such field.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The officer&rsquo;s overall management, motivating employees and leadership.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The annual
bonuses approved by the compensation committee and the board of directors shall be paid to the officers together with the first
monthly salary that is paid after the approval of the annual bonuses by the board of directors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">If annual bonuses
have been paid to officers on the basis of financial measures which at a later stage transpire to be erroneous and are restated
in the financial statements, the officer shall refund the surplus bonuses sums, within one year from the date of the Company&rsquo;s
notice with respect thereto, linked to the consumer price index, and if the officer has received less, the Company shall pay the
missing bonus amounts together with the next monthly salary. The Company, by written notice to the officer 60 days in advance,
may set-off all or part of the surplus bonuses sums from the bonuses owing to the officer in respect of the following years.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">5.2.2.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Special bonus </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">The
Company&rsquo;s compensation committee and the board of directors shall be authorized to award any of the Company&rsquo;s officers a one-time
special bonus of up to a gross amount of NIS 500,000 (in addition to the annual bonus) </FONT>in recognition of a significant achievement
or for completion of an assignment<FONT STYLE="background-color: white">, such as completion of a major transaction or achieving
a major milestone with material effect over the Company&rsquo;s business. Such bonus is individual for any of the Chief Executive Officer,
Deputy Chief Executive Officer or Vice Presidents and should be approved by the Company&rsquo;s compensation committee and board
of directors.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">5.2.3.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Equity-Based Compensation</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">The
Company&rsquo;s compensation committee and board of directors believe, in accordance with common practices of public companies in the
market, that as part of the officers&rsquo; total compensation package it is appropriate to offer a component of equity-based compensation,
the purpose of which is to establish a joint interest between the officers and the Company&rsquo;s shareholders. By virtue of the long-term
nature of equity-based compensation plans, they support the Company&rsquo;s ability to retain senior managers in their position for the
long term and are in the interest of the Company and its shareholders.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 16; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->16<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Amended and Restated Compensation Policy &ndash; Approved on December 24, 2019</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">In
view of the advantages of equity-based compensation plans, the Company shall offer its officers participation in an equity-based
compensation plan according to the provision set forth below:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.2.3.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal"><U>Equity-based compensation plan</U></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Subject to
the approval of the Company&rsquo;s competent organs in accordance with law, the Company shall offer officers and directors, participation
in an equity-based company plan, which may include options to purchase shares or restricted share awards or a combination of both
(herein described collectively as &ldquo;<B>Awards</B>&rdquo;). The equity-based compensation plan shall be defined and implemented
so that it conforms to the requirements of Section 102 of the Income Tax Ordinance in the capital gains track, to the extent possible.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The equity-based
compensation plan to be approved shall include the following:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The maximum number of securities to be granted and the dilution percentage arising from the grants;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The method of allocating the grant among the various offerees and also a reserve for grants to
office holders who may join the Company during the course of the term of the plan;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The Awards shall vest over a minimum period of four years and not more than 25% of the Awards shall
vest in each of such years. The minimum vesting period for the first portion of the grant shall not be less than one year from
the date of grant;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">With respect to options, the exercise price of each option shall be equal to the higher of (i)
the average closing price of the Company&rsquo;s ordinary shares on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange during the 30 trading days prior
to the date of the option grant plus 5%; and (ii) the closing price of the Company&rsquo;s ordinary shares on the Tel Aviv Stock
Exchange on the date of the option grant;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The expiration date of the options - up to 10 years from the date of grant; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->17<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Amended and Restated Compensation Policy &ndash; Approved on December 24, 2019</P></DIV>
