<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.2.3.2.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal"><U>Grants</U></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">In accordance
with the approval of the compensation committee and the board of directors, Awards shall be granted to officers of the Company
in accordance with the terms of the approved equity-based compensation plan. To the extent that an approved plan includes several
grants, the future grants shall be made in accordance with the provisions of the plan and on such dates as prescribed in the plan.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">When a new
officer joins the Company during the course of a plan, the joining officer shall be granted an Award out of the reserve determined
in the plan.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The Awards
granted shall be deposited with a trustee in accordance with the provisions of Section 102 of the Income Tax Ordinance. The trustee
shall report to the offerees about the number of Awards it holds on their behalf, their exercise dates in the case of options and
any other details they require in connection with the grant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The considerations
for the allocation of the Awards among the various offerees shall include:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">&#9679;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The officer&rsquo;s contribution to the Company&rsquo;s success;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.2.3.3.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal"><U>Exercise of Options</U></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Upon vesting
of each portion of an officer&rsquo;s options, the vested options held by the trustee may be exercised into Company shares. The trustee
shall act pursuant to the officers&rsquo; instructions and shall perform for them all the acts required for the exercise of the options
into shares and/or cash.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.2.3.4.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">Maximum Value of Equity-Based Compensation.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">The
maximum value of equity-based compensation for all officers shall be fifteen monthly base salaries.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 17.85pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 21.55pt"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">5.3.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">ADDITIONAL BENEFITS AND PERQUISITES </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: left; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.3.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Pension </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The Company shall
allocate payments to a pension fund (or several pension funds) or a pension agent, all in accordance with the officer&rsquo;s selection
in writing and pursuant to the applicable statutory provisions. The allocations shall be made out of the officer&rsquo;s base salary
only and shall not be comprised of any other compensation components whatsoever. The Company&rsquo;s allocations to pension funds shall
be conditional upon the appropriate contribution from the officer&rsquo;s salary to the pension.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The Company shall
insure officers for loss of earning capacity as part of their participation in a pension fund or as an additional policy for office
holders that have manager insurance. The Company&rsquo;s allocations to insurance for loss of earning capacity shall not exceed 2.5%
of the officer&rsquo;s base salary.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Officers who
are recruited by the Company after the publication of this policy shall sign the general consent form of the Israeli Minister of
Labor pursuant to Section 14 of the Severance Pay Law and the Company shall allocate the officers&rsquo; severance pay into the pension
fund / manager&rsquo;s insurance in accordance with officer&rsquo;s election.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.3.2.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Further Education Fund</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Each month the
Company shall allocate 7.5% of the officer&rsquo;s base salary and shall deduct a further 2.5% of his base salary to a further education
fund at the officer&rsquo;s selection. The allocation and deduction from the officer&rsquo;s salary to a further education fund shall be made
up to maximum amount permitted under the Income Tax Regulations.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.3.3.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Vehicle</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The Company shall
provide officers with a vehicle for their personal use, in accordance with the Company&rsquo;s practice, and the Company shall pay the
cost of maintaining the vehicle. The officer shall pay any tax applicable under any law on the value of the use of the vehicle
placed at his disposal by the Company. The Company shall calculate such tax and shall deduct it from the officer&rsquo;s salary.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.3.4.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Mobile Phone</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The Company shall
provide an officer with a mobile phone for his use, the type of which shall be at the Company&rsquo;s discretion, and the payment for
the cost of use of the phone and the device shall be paid by the Company. The officer shall pay any tax which is likely to be levied
on him due to the use of the mobile telephone at the Company&rsquo;s expense.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.3.5.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Meals</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The officer shall
be entitled to participate in a payment arrangement for meals during working hours as determined in the Company&rsquo;s policy with respect
to all of the Company&rsquo;s employees.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.3.6.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Annual Vacation</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">An officer shall
be entitled to annual vacation in the number of days determined in the annual vacation tables and in accordance with the Company&rsquo;s
policy (or pursuant to the Annual Vacation Law if no such tables have been defined in the Company&rsquo;s policy).</P>



<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.3.7.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Sick Leave</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">An officer shall
be entitled to be absent from work on account of illness pursuant to the provisions of the Sick Pay Law and in accordance with
the Company&rsquo;s policy.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal">5.3.8.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">Recuperation Pay</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">An officer shall
be entitled to recuperation pay pursuant to the Recuperation Pay Law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">6.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">TERMINATION OF OFFICE CONDITIONS</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 39.4pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -21.55pt"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">6.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">ADVANCE NOTICE</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">An officer
shall be entitled to an advance notice period, as determined by the compensation committee or in accordance with the existing agreements
and no more than four months. During the course of the advance notice period, the officer shall be required to continue to fulfill
his position, unless the chief executive officer decides to release him from this obligation, and he shall be entitled to the continuation
of all the terms of office and employment without change with respect to such period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">6.2.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">RETIREMENT AND TERMINATION
AWARDS</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">As a general rule, no retirement
and termination awards shall be determined in the officers&rsquo; personal employment agreements. The board of directors, at the chief
executive officer&rsquo;s recommendation, may approve the offer to an officer who has been employed by the Company for at least
three years, a retirement award in an amount not exceeding twice the officer&rsquo;s base monthly salary. When an officer has been employed
by the Company for five years or more, the board of directors may approve a retirement or termination award which may not exceed
four times the officer&rsquo;s base monthly salary.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: italic bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">6.3.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-style: normal">NON-COMPETITION</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Officers shall undertake in writing,
at the time they enter into an employment agreement with the Company, to refrain from competing with the Company for a period which
is not less than the advance notice period plus the retirement or termination award period to which they shall be entitled after
their retirement from the Company.</P>



<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Officers who are employed in
the Company at the date of publication of the policy and who have not signed a non-competition agreement shall sign an agreement
as above-mentioned as a condition for payment of any retirement or termination award.</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 17.85pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -17.85pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">7.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">EXCULPATION, INDEMNITY AND OFFICERS&rsquo; INSURANCE</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 17.85pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 17.85pt; text-align: justify">Office holders shall be covered
by directors&rsquo; and officers&rsquo; liability insurance which the Company shall acquire, from time to time (the &ldquo;<B>Policy</B>&rdquo;),
subject to the Israeli Companies Law, 1999 (the &ldquo;<B>Companies Law</B>&rdquo;), the Israeli Companies Law Regulations (Reliefs
Regarding Transaction with Interested Parties), 2000 (the &ldquo;<B>Companies Regulations</B>&rdquo;) and any other applicable
law or regulation. Subject to the provisions of the Companies Law, the Companies Regulations and any other applicable law or regulation,
the acquisition, extension, renewal or replacement of the Policy may be approved solely by the Company&rsquo;s compensation committee
provided that (i) the maximum aggregate limit of liability pursuant to the D&amp;O Insurance (including Side &ldquo;A&rdquo; coverage)
shall be not more than US$50,0000,000 (fifty million U.S. Dollars) for each D&amp;O Insurance period; (ii) the annual premium for
each D&amp;O Insurance (including Side &ldquo;A&rdquo; coverage) shall not exceed US$750,000 (seven hundred and fifty thousand
U.S. Dollars); (iii) the maximum aggregate deductible payable by the Company shall not exceed US$2,000,000 (two million U.S. Dollars);
and (iv) the D&amp;O Insurance is on market terms and shall not have a material impact on the Company&rsquo;s profitability, assets
or liabilities.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 17.85pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 17.85pt; text-align: justify">The Company awards, and shall
continue to award, indemnification undertakings to directors and officers, subject to the approvals required in accordance with
the provisions of the Companies Law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 17.85pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 17.85pt; text-align: justify">Subject to the provisions of
the Companies Law, the Company shall be entitled to exculpate in advance an office holder of the Company from liability, in whole
or in part, for damages resulting from a breach of a duty of care towards the Company, subject to the approvals required in accordance
with the Companies Law; provided, however, that the Company may not exempt an office holder for an action or transaction in which
a controlling shareholder (as such term is defined in the Companies Law) or any other office holder (including an office holder
who is not the office holder the Company has undertaken to exempt) has a personal interest (as such term is defined in the Companies
Law).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS, the Parties

case that Kamada supplies a negative Deviation for [*****], Baxalta shall have the option to a) cancel the purchase order for
the number of vials of the negative Deviation, wherein such cancelled purchase order will still count towards Baxalta&rsquo;s
Minimum Purchase Level for [*****]; or b) increase both Baxalta&rsquo;s Minumum Purchase Level for [*****] and Kamada&rsquo;s
Production Capacity for [*****] to add the number of vials of the negative Deviation. Such option for a negative Deviation
shall be exercised by Baxalta by written notice to Kamada by [*****].</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">This Clinical Study
Supply Agreement (the &ldquo;CSSA&rdquo;) is made effective as of May 8<SUP>th</SUP>, 2019 (the &ldquo;CSSA Effective Date&rdquo;)
by and between KAMADA Ltd., an Israeli company, with a principal place of business at 2 Holzman St., Science Park, P.O. Box 4081,
Rehovot, 7670402, Israel (&ldquo;KAMADA&rdquo;) and PARI Pharma GmbH, with its registered office at Moosstrasse 3, 82319 Starnberg,
Germany (&ldquo;PARI&rdquo;). In this CSSA, either PARI or KAMADA is referred to as a &ldquo;Party,&rdquo; and collectively as the
&ldquo;Parties.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center">Recitals</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 28.35pt">WHEREAS, PARI and
KAMADA are parties to a certain License Agreement dated November 16, 2006 (the &ldquo;License Agreement&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 28.35pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 28.35pt">WHEREAS, PARI has
developed and produced an eFlow Technology controller incorporating certain technologies to track, transfer, display and store
information about patients adherence to inhaled medication by using data from their eFlow Technology Nebulizer Systems made available
to the patients and the clinical development team for storing and transmitting nebulizer adherence data (the &ldquo;eTrack Controller
Kit&rdquo; as defined in more detail in Schedule 1, Position No. 1) and the PARItrack Web Portal (as further described in Section
2.5 below) to track, display, store and report patients&rsquo; adherence to inhaled medication by using the transferred nebulization
data from the eTrack Controller, which together allow access to and evaluation of the nebulization data (which is available only
to KAMADA and the clinical research and development team, but not provided to the patient, subject to personal data protection
law as described in more detail in Schedule 2) (the eTrack Controller Kits and the PARItrack Web Portal are collectively referred
to as &ldquo;eTrack&rdquo;); and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 28.35pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 28.35pt">WHEREAS, KAMADA
desires to use the eTrack under the License Agreement for the purpose of conducting its human factor studies and Phase III clinical
trial relating to its Drug Product, in accordance with the License Agreement (the &ldquo;Evaluation Studies&rdquo;), as set forth
under Article 6 &ldquo;The Device and its Supply&rdquo; thereof; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 28.35pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 28.35pt">WHERAS, PARI, being
the owner of the entire right (including intellectual property rights), title and interest in eTrack, is willing to provide KAMADA
with the eTrack Controller Kits (comprising certain accessories as described in Schedule 1 hereto) and Nebulizer Handsets and
to provide access to the PARItrack Web Portal for the sole purpose of conducting the clinical Evaluation Studies in accordance
with the provisions of the License Agreement; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 28.35pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 28.35pt"></P>

the Parties agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 28.35pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 28.35pt">1.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left">Supply and use of material</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; text-indent: -28.35pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 28.35pt">1.1</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Provision of Material</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -28.35pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">PARI will provide eTrack Controller
Kits with monitoring and data transmission functionality used to operate and control Nebulizer Handsets as part of the Device
and as specified in Schedule 1 of this CSSA to KAMADA to conduct the clinical Evaluation Studies under Section 6 of the License

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">The investigational eFlow

long such Study is conducted. Ownership to such nebulizer system will not be transferred to you and you are obligated to return
the nebulizer system after the conclusion of the Study or anytime upon request.</P>

                                         eFlow Technology nebulizer system</TD>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">The nebulizer system is intended
to be used by you exclusively for the purpose to conduct the Study.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">You are not allowed to:</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 28.35pt">2.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">INFORMATION AND CONSENT TO THE PROCESSING
                                         OF PERSONAL DATA WITH ETRACK</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -28.35pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">You are thinking of taking part in the
clinical study [Partner_Study_Title_No]. This study will be conducted by using an eTrack Controller which will collect and transfer
certain data about your use of the device. We hereby inform you as follows with respect to the processing of your personal data:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 28.35pt; text-align: left">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">What data will
                                         be processed and what is the purpose of the processing?</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">The eTrack Controller, once
connected to the internet via the wireless hub, will collect and transfer the serial number of the inhalation device and certain
data about the use of the device such as the time of starting the nebulization and the time nebulization ends. Additional technical
data of your inhalation device may be processed as well. Other data like your name, address, birthdate, etc. will not be transmitted
but an allocation of the processed data to your person will take place at the receiving study centers via the serial number of
your eTrack Controller. This is why we consider the pseudonymized data processed as your personal data.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-top: Black 1.5pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 90%"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt 0; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Clinical Study Supply Agreement Kamada-PARI<BR> Effective Date: May 8<SUP>th</SUP>, 2019, Version: 1.0</P></TD><TD STYLE="width: 10%; text-align: right">&nbsp;<!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->15<!-- Field: /Sequence -->/35</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">Your personal and sensitive
data will be collected and processed for the following purposes:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">Provision of telemedicine
services, in particular delivery of data showing the adherence to inhaled medication in the course of the clinical study [Partner_Study_Title_No].</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 28.35pt; text-align: left">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Modalities of processing</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">Your data will be processed
by means of electronic devices and will be transmitted through IT networks with a high level of security. In particular, all preventative
measures set forth in data protection legislation, including measures for segregation and encryption of data, will be adopted.
Your data will be encrypted directly after creation within the eTrack Controller and transmitted only in encrypted form and without
connection to your name (i.e. pseudonymous). Third parties involved in data transmission, other than the receiving healthcare
professionals at the study centers as well as the principal investigator of the study, will not have the means to de-pseudonym
your data.</P>

through IT instruments that will allow health operators to access patients&rsquo; information and monitor their treatment. Access
to your health data may only occur through the points of access authorized to access such data by authorized health operators.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 28.35pt; text-align: justify">Your data will be transmitted,
by means of an IT network, to a central collection system. In order to make your data accessible to authorized health operators,
your data may be processed by third parties entrusted with technical, logistic, IT, storage and transmission services. If collected
within the European Union, your data will not be transferred outside the European Union. However, your data may be accessible
in pseudonymized and encrypted form only for purposes of 24/7 technical support provided by service personnel in other territories
by contractors of the data processor who are bound by confidentiality obligations and EU Commission standard contractual clauses
outside of the European Union, including but not limited to the United States of America, whose legislation may not ensure the
same level of protection of personal data as the one ensured in the European Union.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>DATA PROCESSING AGREEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Data Processing Agreement set forth
in this Schedule 3 hereby is incorporated into and made part of the CSSA. This Schedule 3 shall apply when KAMADA is acting as
a data controller (particularly in the meaning of Article 4 No.7 of EU Regulation 2016/679) (&ldquo;Controller&rdquo;), and PARI
is acting as a data processor for KAMADA (particularly in the meaning of Article 4 No.8 of EU Regulation 2016/679) (&ldquo;Processor&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 35.7pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -17.85pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 18pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 28.5pt">8.1</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Termination. This Schedule 3 terminates
                                         automatically, if the CSSA terminates. In addition, if either party knows of a pattern
                                         of activity or practice of the other party that constitutes a material breach or violation
                                         of this Schedule 3 then the non-breaching party shall provide written notice of the breach
                                         or violation to the other party that specifies the nature of the breach or violation.
                                         The breaching party shall cure the breach or end the violation on or before thirty (30)
                                         days after receipt of the written notice. In the absence of a cure reasonably satisfactory
                                         to the non-breaching party within the specified timeframe, or in the event the breach
                                         is reasonably incapable of cure, then the non-breaching party may, if feasible, terminate
                                         the CSSA, including this Schedule 3.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 46.5pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -28.5pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 18pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 28.5pt">8.2</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Effect of Termination or Expiration.
                                         Within sixty (60) days after the expiration or termination for any reason of the CSSA
                                         or this Schedule 3, PARI shall upon KAMADA&rsquo;s choice return or destroy all PHI,
                                         if feasible to do so, including all PHI in possession of PARI&rsquo;s agents or subcontractors.
                                         In the event that PARI determines that return or destruction of the PHI is not feasible,
                                         PARI shall notify KAMADA in writing and may retain the PHI subject to this Section 8.2
                                         if permitted by GDPR. Under any circumstances, PARI shall extend any and all protections,
                                         limitations and restrictions contained in this Schedule 3 to PARI&rsquo;s use or disclosure
                                         of any PHI retained after the expiration or termination of the CSSA or this Schedule
                                         3, and shall limit any further uses or disclosures solely to the purposes that make return
                                         or destruction of the PHI infeasible.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><B>Description of
Technical and Organizational Safeguards</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">This Exhibit 1 forms an integral part
of Schedule 3 (Data Processing Agreement)</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Physical
                                         access control</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Are there any regulations governing
access to the building, to the computer centre and to the premises comprising the IT infrastructure?</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Explanations /
comments: </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The physical approach to a data
processing system (&ldquo;<B>DPS</B>&rdquo;) must be controlled. Unauthorised persons must be prevented from gaining access to
and operating the DPS in any way.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.15pt">Examples:
- access control system, badge reader</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.15pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- magnetic card, chip card</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- keys, key allocation</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- door lock mechanism (electrical
door opener, etc.)</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- company security, gatekeeper</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- monitoring facility, alarm
system, video/closed-circuit TV</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><B>Measures
implemented on Data Processor&rsquo;s premises:</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">PARI IT infrastructure components are
located in two separated data centres at Moosstra&szlig;e 3, 82319 Starnberg. Access to these data centres is controlled by E-Token/smartcard
and allowed only to defined persons.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">SAP infrastructure as well as digital
infrastructure are hosted by QSC AG in Hamburg (contract information available if requested). QSC is audited by PARI QM department.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left">2.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Computer access
                                         control</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Are there any regulations
governing the use of DP systems?</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Explanations /
comments: </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Any unauthorised use of DPS
must be prevented, no matter whether or not such use is effected by means of data transmission equipment (e.g. via the internet).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 36pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 56.15pt">Examples:</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">- password procedures (including
                                         special characters, minimum length, regular change of password)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 99.25pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -63.25pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- automatic blocking (e.g.
password or pausing)</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- setting up one user master
record per user</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- encryption of data volumes</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Measures implemented
on Data Processor&rsquo;s premises:</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Use of Laptops/desktops is secured
by E-Token/smartcard and Password; every application needs user and Password authentication.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left">3.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Data access control</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Are there any regulations
governing the allocation of user rights, their modification and withdrawal?</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Explanations /
comments: </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">It must be ensured that the
authorised persons have access only to those data they are authorised to access. A set of rules for the allocation and withdrawal
of authorisations must be organised and implemented to protect personal data, at all stages of their collection, processing and
use and after their storage, in such a way that they cannot be read, copied, altered or removed by unauthorised persons.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 31; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-top: Black 1.5pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 90%"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt 0; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Clinical Study Supply Agreement Kamada-PARI<BR> Effective Date: May 8<SUP>th</SUP>, 2019, Version: 1.0</P></TD><TD STYLE="width: 10%; text-align: right">&nbsp;<!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->31<!-- Field: /Sequence -->/35</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 36pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 56.15pt">Examples:</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">- differentiated authorisations
                                         (profiles, roles, transactions, objects), data encryption</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 99.25pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -63.25pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Measures implemented
on Data Processor&rsquo;s premises:</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>There must be a written request for
system access and authorisation (documented by Sharepoint workflow) made by GPO&rsquo;s (Global process owner) or line manager;
they define which role IT adds to a specific person. </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>All Laptop Harddrives are encrypted
by Bitlocker.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>The eFlow data are encrypted (transformation:
Rijndael/ECB/NoPadding; Algorithm: AES).</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left">4.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Disclosure control</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Is the transfer or transmission
of data controlled? Is the dispatch of data volumes (including paper) controlled? Are there any regulations governing the transmission
of sensitive or personal data (passwords, encryption, etc.)? Are there any process-independent plausibility and security checks
in place upon data input by the Data Processor? Are the results checked for correctness by the Controller?</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Explanations /
comments: </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">During transport or electronic
transmission, personal data must be protected in such a way that they cannot be read, copied, altered or removed by unauthorised
persons (encryption may be an option). Besides the verifiability and traceability of data transmission it must be ensured that
unauthorised persons are prevented from accessing the data during their transmission. Since this cannot be guaranteed by technical
means at this point, it must be ensured that any modification or deletion of data can be recognised.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 36pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 56.15pt">Examples:</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">- encryption / tunnelling
                                         connection (VPN = Virtual Private Network)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.15pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- electronic signature</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- logging</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- transport protection</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Measures implemented
on Data Processor&rsquo;s premises:</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>If somebody wants to have access to
our infrastructure from outside our network, again a specific written request is needed (documented by Sharepoint workflow) and
if allowed implemented by VPN tunnel. </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>In SAP we have implemented the Standard
SAP Audit Trail as well as an extended Audit Trail. </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left">5.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Input control</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Are the collection,
modification and deletion of personal data logged?</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Explanations /
comments: </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">It must be ensured (by logging)
that it is possible after the fact to check and ascertain whether personal data have been entered, altered or removed, and if
so, when and by whom.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 36pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 56.15pt">Examples:</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">- logging systems and report
                                         evaluation systems</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.15pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Measures implemented
on Data Processor&rsquo;s premises:</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>See point 4 Audit
Trail and extended Audit Trail</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left">6.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Job control</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Is it ensured that the data
to be processed by the Data Processor are processed exclusively according to the Controller&rsquo;s instructions? Are these instructions
implemented by the Data Processor without delay? Are there any checks in place to prevent the data from being copied, altered
or transmitted to unauthorised third parties?</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Explanations /
comments: </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">It must be verified and ensured
that personal data processed on behalf of others are processed strictly in compliance with the Controller&rsquo;s instructions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 36pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 56.15pt">Examples:</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">- obligation of staff involved
                                         in data processing to maintain data secrecy</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.15pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- code of conduct for data
processing by the Data Processor</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- procedures for revealing
any error instructions</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- checking compliance with
instructions</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- granting the Controller
monitoring rights as per data privacy agreement</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Measures implemented
on Data Processor&rsquo;s premises:</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>The use of IT Systems is described
in a standard operating procedure of PARI.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>PARI IT is audited by internal QM department
as well as external audits by cancom/acentrix (detailed audit documentation available if requested).</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left">7.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Availability control</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Does the Data Processor has
a backup scheme in place and is it checked at regular intervals? Are there any disaster response exercises in place? Is the place
of storage and processing clearly identified? Has the storage period for the data sets and possibly for the software been defined?</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Explanations /
comments: </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The availability of personal
data must be ensured. Appropriate measures are to be taken to protect DPS (hardware and software) against accidental destruction
(disaster case).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 36pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 56.15pt">Examples:</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">- backup procedures</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.15pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- mirror disks, e.g. RAID
procedure</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- uninterruptible power supply
(UPS)</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- separate storage</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- antivirus protection, firewall</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- contingency plan</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Measures implemented
on Data Processor&rsquo;s premises and are described in several standard operation procedures at PARI.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Data are hosted by QSC AG; Information
regarding backup procedure etc are available if requested.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left">8.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Separation control</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Has the separation control requirement
been fulfilled to ensure the separate processing of data collected for different purposes (separation rule)? Are the systems multi-client
capable?</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Explanations /
comments: </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">It must be ensured that personal
data collected for different purposes can be processed separately. Logical rather than physical separation is required.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 36pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 56.15pt">Examples:</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">- &ldquo;internal client
                                         capability&rdquo; / earmarking</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.15pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">- functional separation (production,
testing)</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 92.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Measures implemented
on Data Processor&rsquo;s premises:</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Data access is based on different roles
so that the users only see the data they need for work.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Relevant system landscape is separated

    <TD STYLE="border-top: Black 1.5pt solid; border-right: Black 1.5pt solid; border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid; padding: 6pt 5.4pt; width: 77%"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Exclusive Distribution Agreement
        will set forth in detail the respective responsibilities and obligations of the Parties (including any regulatory responsibilities
        and requirements) with respect to the grant by COMPANY to SUPPLIER of exclusive marketing and distribution rights with
        respect to the Product in the Exclusive Distribution Territories, including, but not limited to, the following:</P>
        <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

        Exclusive Marketing &amp; Distribution Rights - COMPANY shall grant to the SUPPLIER the exclusive rights to market and
        distribute the Product in Israel and the Palestinian Territories during the period of the Supply Agreement.</P>

        and marketing rights.</P>
