    <ifrs-full:DisclosureOfIncomeTaxExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0; width: 0.75in; text-align: left"&gt;&lt;font style="font: small-caps 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Note&#13;                          21: -&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: small-caps 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Taxes&#13;                                         on Income&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 0.75in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 0.5in; text-align: left"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Tax&#13;laws applicable to the Company&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 113.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Law&#13;for the Encouragement of Industry (Taxes), 1969 &lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 113.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Law for the Encouragement of Industry (Taxes), 1969 (the &amp;#8220;Encouragement of Industry Law&amp;#8221;), provides several tax&#13;benefits for &amp;#8220;Industrial Companies.&amp;#8221; Pursuant to the Encouragement of Industry Law, a company qualifies as an&#13;Industrial Company if it is a resident of Israel and at least 90% of its income in any tax year (exclusive of income from&#13;certain defense loans) is generated from an &amp;#8220;Industrial Enterprise&amp;#8221; that it owns. An Industrial Enterprise is&#13;defined as an enterprise whose principal activity, in a given tax year, is industrial activity.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;An&#13;Industrial Company is entitled to certain tax benefits, including: (i) a deduction of the cost of purchases of patents, know-how&#13;and certain other intangible property rights (other than goodwill) used for the development or promotion of the Industrial Enterprise&#13;in equal amounts over a period of eight years, beginning from the year in which such rights were first used, (ii) the right to&#13;elect to file consolidated tax returns, under certain conditions, with additional Israeli Industrial Companies under its control,&#13;and (iii) the right to deduct expenses related to public offerings in equal amounts over a period of three years beginning from&#13;the year of the offering.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Eligibility&#13;for benefits under the Encouragement of Industry Law is not contingent upon the approval of any governmental authority. The Company&#13;believes that it currently qualifies as an industrial company within the definition of the Industry Encouragement Law. The Company&#13;cannot confirm that the Israeli tax authorities will agree that the Company qualifies, or, if qualified, that it will continue&#13;to qualify as an industrial company or that the benefits described above will be available to the Company in the future.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 113.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Law&#13;for the Encouragement of Capital Investments, 1959&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 56.7pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Tax&#13;benefits prior to Amendment 60&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 56.7pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 28.35pt; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company&amp;#8217;s facilities in Israel have been granted Approved Enterprise status under the Law for the Encouragement of&#13;Capital Investments, 1959, commonly referred to as the &amp;#8220;Investment Law&amp;#8221;. The Investment Law provides that capital&#13;investments in a production facility (or other eligible assets) may be designated as an Approved Enterprise. Until 2005, the&#13;designation required advance approval from the Investment Center of the Israel Ministry of Industry, Trade and Labor. Each&#13;certificate of approval for an Approved Enterprise (&amp;#8220;Certificate of Approval&amp;#8221;) relates to a specific investment&#13;program, delineated both by the financial scope of the investment and by the physical characteristics of the facility or the&#13;asset.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Under&#13;the Approved Enterprise programs, a company is eligible for governmental grants (&amp;#8220;Grants Track&amp;#8221;). Under the Grants&#13;Track the Company is eligible for investments grants awarded at various rates according to the development area in which the plant&#13;is located: in Development Zone A the rate is 24% and in Development Zone B the rate is 10%. In addition to the above grants,&#13;the Company is eligible to tax exemption at the first two years of the benefit period (as define below) and is subject to reduced&#13;corporate tax of 10% to 25% during the remaining five to eight years (depending on the extent of foreign investment in the Company)&#13;of the benefit period. The benefits period is limited to the earlier of 12 years from completion of the investment or commencement&#13;of production (&amp;#8220;Year of Operation&amp;#8221;), or 14 years from the year in which the certificate of approval was obtained.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;benefit period for part of the Company plants has ended by 2017.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Under&#13;the Investment Law a company may elect to receive an alternative package comprised of tax benefits (&amp;#8220;Alternative&#13;Track&amp;#8221;) instead of the above mentioned grants Track. Under the Alternative Track, a company&amp;#8217;s undistributed&#13;income derived from an Approved Enterprise is exempt from corporate tax for an initial period of two to ten years (depending&#13;on the geographic location of the Approved Enterprise within Israel which begins in the first year that the Company realizes&#13;taxable income from the Approved Enterprise following the year of operation (as define below). After expiration of the&#13;initial tax exemption period, the Company is eligible for a reduced corporate tax rate of 10% to 25% for the following five&#13;to eight years, depending on the extent of foreign investment in the Company (as shown in the table below). The benefits&#13;period is limited to 12 years from the Year of Operation, or 14 years from the year in which the certificate of approval was&#13;obtained, whichever is earlier.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Tax&#13;benefits under Amendment 60&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;On&#13;April 1, 2005, an amendment to the Investment Law was effected (&amp;#8220;Amendment 60&amp;#8221;). The amendment revised the criteria&#13;for investments qualified to receive tax benefits. An eligible investment program under the amendment will qualify for benefits&#13;as a Privileged Enterprise (rather than the previous terminology of Approved Enterprise).&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Pursuant&#13;to the Amendment, to be entitled to receive the tax benefits, a company must make an investment in the Privileged Enterprise exceeding&#13;a certain percentage or a minimum amount specified in the Investments Law. Such investment may be made over a period of no more&#13;than three years ending at the end of the year in which the company requested to have the tax benefits apply to the Privileged&#13;Enterprise (the &amp;#8220;Year of Election&amp;#8221;).&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company received a Tax Ruling from the Israeli Tax Authority that its activity is an industrial activity and the Company will&#13;be eligible for the status of a Privileged Enterprise, provided that it meets the requirements under the ruling. The Year of Election&#13;is 2009.The Company also obtained 2012 as a Year of Election.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;duration of tax benefits is subject to a limitation of the earlier of 7 to 10 years (depending on the extent of foreign investment&#13;in the company) from the first year in which the company generated taxable income (at, or after, the year of election) , or 12&#13;years from the first day of the Year of Election. The amendment does not apply to investment programs approved prior to December&amp;#160;31,&#13;2004. The new tax regime applies to new investment programs only.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;tax benefits available under Approved Enterprise or Privileged Enterprise relate only to taxable income attributable to the specific&#13;Approved Enterprise or Privileged Enterprise, and the Company&amp;#8217;s effective tax rate will be the result of a weighted combination&#13;of the applicable rates.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;benefits available to an Approved Enterprise and a Privileged Enterprise are conditioned upon terms stipulated in the Investment&#13;Law and the related regulations and the criteria (for an Approved Enterprise) set forth in the applicable certificate of approval.&#13;If the Company does not fulfill these conditions, in whole or in part, the benefits can be cancelled and may be required to refund&#13;the amount of the benefits, linked to the Israeli consumer price index plus interest. The Company believes that its Privileged&#13;Enterprise programs currently operate in compliance with all applicable conditions and criteria.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;the event that a company declares and pays dividends from tax-exempt income, the company will be taxed on the otherwise exempt&#13;income at the same reduced corporate tax rate that would have applied to that income. Payment of dividends derived from income&#13;that was taxed at reduced rates, but not tax-exempt, does not result in additional tax consequences to the company. Shareholders&#13;who receive dividends derived from Approved Enterprise or Privileged Enterprise income are generally taxed at a rate of 15%, which&#13;is withheld and paid by the company paying the dividend, if the dividend is distributed during the benefits period or within the&#13;following 12 years (the limitation does not apply to a Foreign Investors Company, which is a company that more than 25% of its&#13;shares owned by non-Israeli residents).&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Preferred&#13;Enterprise &lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;i&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/i&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Tax&#13;Benefits under the 2011 Amendment&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;As&#13;of January 1, 2011 new legislation amending to the Investment Law was effected (the &amp;#8220;2011 Amendment&amp;#8221;). Pursuant to&#13;the amendment a new status of &amp;#8220;Preferred Company&amp;#8221; and &amp;#8220;Preferred Enterprise&amp;#8221;, replacing the existed status&#13;of &amp;#8220;Privileged Company&amp;#8221; and &amp;#8220;Privileged Enterprise&amp;#8221;. Similarly to &amp;#8220;Beneficiary Company&amp;#8221;, a&#13;Preferred Company is an industrial company owning a Preferred Enterprise which meets certain conditions (including a minimum threshold&#13;of 25% export). However, under this new legislation the requirement for a minimum investment in productive assets was cancelled.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Under&#13;the 2011 Amendment, a uniform corporate tax rate will apply to all qualifying income of the Preferred Company, as opposed to the&#13;former law, which was limited to income from the Approved Enterprises and Beneficiary Enterprise during the&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;benefits&#13;period. The uniform corporate tax rate will be 7% in Development Area A, and 12.5% elsewhere in Israel.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;On&#13;August 5, 2013, the &amp;#8220;Knesset&amp;#8221; issued the Law for Changing National Priorities (Legislative Amendments for Achieving&#13;Budget Targets for 2013 and 2014), which consists of Amendment 71 to the Encouragement Law (&amp;#8220;the Amendment&amp;#8221;). According&#13;to the Amendment, the tax rate on preferred income from a Preferred Enterprise in 2014 and onwards will be 9% in Development Area&#13;A, and 16% elsewhere in Israel.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Amendment also prescribes that any dividends distributed to individuals or foreign residents from the preferred enterprise&amp;#8217;s earnings&#13;as above will be subject to tax at a rate of 20% from 2014 and onwards (or a reduced rate under an applicable double tax treaty).&#13;Upon a distribution of a dividend to an Israeli company, no withholding tax is remitted.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 56.7pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.7pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.25in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;December 2016, the Israeli &amp;#8220;Knesset&amp;#8221; amended the Investment Law.     <ifrs-full:DisclosureOfAccountingJudgementsAndEstimatesExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: small-caps 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Note&#13;3: -&amp;#160;Significant Accounting Judgments, Estimates And Assumptions Used In The Preparation Of The Financial Statements&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;the process of applying the significant accounting policies, the Group has made the following judgments which have the most significant&#13;effect on the amounts recognized in the financial statements:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Judgments&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Determining the fair value of&#13;share-based payment transactions&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify"&gt;The fair value of share-based payment transactions&#13;is determined upon initial recognition by an acceptable option pricing model. The inputs to the model include share price, exercise&#13;price and assumptions regarding expected volatility, expected life of share option and expected dividend yield.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 70.9pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 70.9pt"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Discount rate for a lease liability&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 70.9pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;When the Company is unable to readily&#13;determine the discount rate implicit in a lease in order to measure the lease liability, the Company uses an incremental borrowing&#13;rate. That rate represents the rate of interest that the Company would have to pay to borrow over a similar term and with similar&#13;security, the funds necessary to obtain an asset of similar value to the right-of-use asset in a similar economic environment.&#13;When there are no financing transactions that can serve as a basis, the Company determines the incremental borrowing rate based&#13;on its credit risk, the lease term and other economic variables deriving from the lease contract's conditions and restrictions.&#13;In certain situations, the Company is assisted by an external valuation expert in determining the incremental borrowing rate.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Revenue&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company assesses the criteria for recognition of revenue related to up-front payments and milestones as outlined by IFRS 15.&#13;Judgment is necessary to determine over which period the Company will satisfy its performance obligations related to up-&#13;front payments and milestones and whether financing component exists. For additional information, refer to Note&#13;17a.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Inventory&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Work&#13;in process and Finished Good including direct and indirect costs. The allocation of indirect costs is accounted for on a quarterly&#13;basis by dividing the total quarterly indirect manufacturing cost to the batches manufactured during that quarter based on predetermined&#13;allocation factors. The criteria for allocation of indirect manufacturing expense to manufactured batches which eventually effect&#13;our inventory value is subject to Company judgment.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;b.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Estimates&#13;                                         and assumptions&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;preparation of the financial statements requires management to make estimates and assumptions that have an effect on the application&#13;of the accounting policies and on the reported amounts of assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses. Changes in accounting estimates&#13;are reported in the period of the change in estimate.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;key assumptions made in the financial statements concerning uncertainties at the end of the reporting period and the critical&#13;estimates computed by the Company that may result in a material adjustment to the carrying amounts of assets and liabilities within&#13;the next financial year are discussed below.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Pensions&#13;                                         and other post-employment benefits&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;liability in respect of post-employment defined benefit plans is determined using actuarial valuations. The actuarial valuation&#13;involves making assumptions about, among others, discount rates, expected rates of return on assets, future salary increases and&#13;mortality rates. Due to the long-term nature of these plans, such estimates are subject to significant uncertainty.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 0.5in; text-align: left"&gt;-&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Lease extension and/or termination options&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 113.4pt; text-indent: -5.4pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;In evaluating whether it is reasonably certain that&#13;the Company will exercise an option to extend a lease or not exercise an option to terminate a lease, the Company considers all&#13;relevant facts and circumstances that create an economic incentive for the Company to exercise the option to extend or not exercise&#13;the option to terminate such as: significant amounts invested in leasehold improvements, the significance of the underlying asset&#13;to the Company's operation and whether it is a specialized asset, the Company's past experience with similar leases, etc.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 113.4pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;After the commencement date, the Company reassesses&#13;the term of the lease upon the occurrence of a significant event or a significant change in circumstances that affects whether&#13;the Company is reasonably certain to exercise an option or not exercise an option previously included in the determination of&#13;the lease term, such as significant leasehold improvements that had not been anticipated on the lease commencement date, sublease&#13;of the underlying asset for a period that exceeds the end of the previously determined lease period, etc.&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; For products with an approved indication, raw materials&#13;and purchased drug product associated with development programs are included in inventory and charged to research and development&#13;expense when consumed. The cost of inventories comprises costs of purchase of raw and other&#13;materials and costs incurred in bringing the inventories to their present location and condition. Net realizable value is the&#13;estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business, net of selling expenses. The estimation of realizable value can effect&#13;on the inventory value at the period end.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Recognition&#13;                                         of deferred tax asset in respect of carry forward tax losses&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify"&gt;Deferred tax assets are recognized&#13;for unused carryforward tax losses and deductible temporary differences to the extent that it is probable that taxable profit&#13;will be available against which the losses can be utilized. Significant management judgment is required to determine the amount&#13;of deferred tax assets that can be recognized, based upon the timing and level of future taxable profits, its source and the tax&#13;planning strategy. For information regarding deferred taxes recognition, please refer to note 21.&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: small-caps 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 6.85pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Impairment&#13;                                         test for the production facility&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company performed an impairment test of its production facility. The Company calculated the recoverable amount of the production&#13;facility to determine whether the book value exceeds its recoverable amount. The impairment test was based on a Discount Cash&#13;Flow ("DCF") model using the Company's long term forecast. As of December 31, 2019 no impairment was recorded&#13;as the recoverable amount exceeded the book value.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 6.85pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 0.5in; text-align: left"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Legal&#13;claims&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 7pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 7pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;estimating the likelihood of outcome of legal claims filed against the Company, the Company relies on the opinion of its legal&#13;counsel. These estimates are based on the legal counsel's best professional judgment, taking into account the stage of proceedings&#13;and historical legal precedents in respect of the different issues. Since the outcome of the claims will be determined in courts,&#13;the results could differ from these estimates.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DisclosureOfAccountingJudgementsAndEstimatesExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.45pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;i.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Research&#13;                                         and development costs &lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Research&#13;expenditures are recognized in profit or loss when incurred and include preclinical and clinical costs (as well as cost of materials&#13;associated with the development of new products or existing products for new therapeutic indications). In addition, these costs&#13;include additional product development activities with respect to approved and distributed products as well as post marketing&#13;commitment research and development activities.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;An&#13;intangible asset arising from a development project or from the development phase of an internal project is recognized if the&#13;Company can demonstrate the technical feasibility of completing the intangible asset so that it will be available for use or sale;&#13;the Company's intention to complete the intangible asset and use or sell it; the Company's ability to use or sell&#13;the intangible asset; how the intangible asset will generate future economic benefits; the availability of adequate technical,&#13;financial and other resources to complete the intangible asset; and the Company's ability to measure reliably the expenditure&#13;attributable to the intangible asset during its development. Since the Company development projects are often subject to regulatory&#13;approval procedures and other uncertainties, the conditions for the capitalization of costs incurred before receipt of approvals&#13;are not normally satisfied and therefore, development expenditures are recognized in profit or loss when incurred.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForRecognitionOfRevenue contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;j.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Revenue&#13;                                         recognition&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;On&#13;January 1, 2018, the Company initially adopted IFRS 15, &amp;#8220;Revenue from Contracts with Customers&amp;#8221; (&amp;#8220;the Standard&amp;#8221;).&#13;The Company elected to apply the provisions of the Standard using the modified retrospective method with the application of certain&#13;practical expedients and without restatement of comparative data. The accounting policy for revenue recognition applied from January&#13;1, 2018, is as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company recognizes revenue&#13;when the customer obtains control over the promised goods or services. Revenues are recognized at an amount that reflects the&#13;consideration to which an entity expects to be entitled in exchange for transferring goods or services to a customer. The Company&#13;includes variable consideration, such as milestone payments or volume rebates, in the transaction price only when it is highly&#13;probable that its inclusion will not result in a significant revenue reversal in the future when the uncertainty has been subsequently&#13;resolved&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;determining the amount of revenue from contracts with customers, the Company evaluates whether it is a principal or an agent in&#13;the arrangement. The Company is a principal when the Company controls the promised goods or services before transferring them&#13;to the customer. In these circumstances, the Company recognizes revenue for the gross amount of the consideration.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Identifying&#13;the contract&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company account for a contract with a customer only when all of the following criteria are met:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;                                         parties to the contract have approved the contract (in writing, orally or in accordance&#13;                                         with other customary business practices) and are committed to perform their respective&#13;                                         obligations;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif;
