width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;b)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;                                         Company can identify each party&amp;#8217;s rights regarding the goods or services to be&#13;                                         transferred;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;c)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;                                         Company can identify the payment terms for the goods or services to be transferred;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;d)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;                                         contract has commercial substance (i.e. the risk, timing or amount of the entity&amp;#8217;s&#13;                                         future cash flows is expected to change as a result of the contract); and&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;e)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;It&#13;                                         is probable that the Company will collect the consideration to which it will be entitled&#13;                                         in exchange for the goods or services that will be transferred to the customer&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;For&#13;the purpose of paragraph (e) the Company examines, inter alia, the percentage of the advance payments received and the spread&#13;of the contractual payments, past experience with the customer and the status and existence of sufficient collateral.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Combination&#13;of contracts&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company accounts for multiple contracts as a single contract when all the contracts are signed at or near the same time with the&#13;same customer or with related parties of the customer, and when one of the following criteria is met:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;                                         contracts are negotiated as a package with a single commercial objective.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;b)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;                                         amount of consideration to be paid in one contract depends on the consideration of another&#13;                                         contract.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;c)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;                                         goods or services that the Company will provide according to the contracts represent&#13;                                         a single performance obligation for the Company.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Identifying&#13;performance obligations&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;On&#13;the contract&amp;#8217;s inception date the Company assesses the goods or services promised in the contract with the customer and&#13;identifies the performance obligations in it.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company identifies the performance obligations when the customer can benefit from the good or service either on its own or together&#13;with other resources that are readily available to the customer and the Company promise to transfer the good or service to the&#13;customer is separately identifiable from other promises in the contract.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Determining&#13;the transaction price&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;transaction price is the amount of the consideration that is expected to be received based on the contract terms. The Company&#13;takes into account the effects of all the following elements when determining the transaction price:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.3pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Variable&#13;                                         consideration &amp;#8211; The Company determines the transaction price separately for each&#13;                                         contract with a customer. When exercising this judgment, the Company evaluates the effect&#13;                                         of each variable amount in the contract, taking into consideration discounts, penalties,&#13;                                         variations, claims, and non-cash consideration. The Company includes the estimated variable&#13;                                         consideration in the transaction price only to the extent it is highly probable that&#13;                                         a significant reversal in the amount of cumulative revenue recognized will not occur&#13;                                         when the uncertainty is resolved. The Company updates the estimated transaction price&#13;                                         to represent faithfully the circumstances present at the end of the reporting period&#13;                                         and the changes in circumstances during the reporting period.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.3pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;b)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Existence&#13;                                         of a significant financing component &amp;#8211; the Company adjusts the amount of the promised&#13;                                         consideration in respect of the effects of the time value of money when certain advance&#13;                                         payments provide the Company with a significant financing benefit. The financing component&#13;                                         is recognized as interest expenses over the period, which are calculated according to&#13;                                         the effective interest method.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.3pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;c)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Non-cash&#13;                                         consideration - Non-cash consideration is measured at the fair value for goods receivable&#13;                                         on a contract&amp;#8217;s inception.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.3pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;d)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Consideration&#13;                                         payable to customers- The Company accounts for payments made to a customer as a reduction&#13;                                         of the revenues from the customer when the Company recognizes revenue from the transfer&#13;                                         of goods or services to the customer or the Company pays the consideration or promises&#13;                                         to pay the consideration in accordance with the Company&amp;#8217;s customary business practices.&#13;                                         When the consideration payable to a customer is a payment for a distinct good or service&#13;                                         from the customer, then the Company accounts for the purchase of the good or service&#13;                                         in the same way it accounts for other purchases from suppliers.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Allocating&#13;the transaction price&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;For&#13;contracts that consist of more than one performance obligation, at contract inception the Company allocates the contract transaction&#13;price to each performance obligation identified in the contract on a relative stand-alone selling price basis. The stand-alone&#13;selling price is the price at which the Company would sell the promised goods or services separately to a customer. When the stand-alone&#13;selling price is not directly observable by reference to similar transactions with similar customers, the Company applies suitable&#13;methods for estimating the stand-alone selling price including: the adjusted market assessment approach, the expected cost plus&#13;a margin approach and the residual approach. The Company may also use a combination of these approaches to allocate the transaction&#13;price in the contract.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Satisfaction&#13;of performance obligations&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company recognizes revenue from contracts with customers when the control over the goods or services is transferred to the customer.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;For&#13;most contracts, revenue recognition occurs at a point in time when control of the asset is transferred to the customer, generally&#13;on delivery of the goods. For agreements with a strategic partner, performance obligations are generally satisfied over time,&#13;given that the customer both simultaneously receives and consumes the benefits provided by the Company, or receives assets with&#13;no alternative use, for which the Company has an enforceable right to payment for performance completed to date. The method for&#13;measuring the progress of performance obligations that are satisfied over time usually based upon the deliverables forming part&#13;of performance obligations.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Contract&#13;modifications&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;A&#13;contract modification is a change in the scope or price (or both) of a contract that was approved by the parties to the contract.&#13;A contract modification can be approved in writing, orally or be implied by customary business practices. A contract modification&#13;can take place also when the parties to the contract have a disagreement regarding the scope or price (or both) of the modification&#13;or when the parties have approved the modification in scope of the contract but have not yet agreed on the corresponding price&#13;modification.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;When&#13;a contract modification has not yet been approved by the parties, the Company continues to recognize revenues according to the&#13;existing contract, while disregarding the contract modification, until the date the contract modification is approved or the contract&#13;modification is legally enforceable.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company accounts for a contract modification as an adjustment of the existing contract since the remaining goods or services after&#13;the contract modification are not distinct and therefore constitute a part of one performance obligation that is partially satisfied&#13;on the date of the contract modification. The effect of the modification on the transaction price and on the rate of progress&#13;towards full satisfaction of the performance obligation is recognized as an adjustment to revenues (increase or decrease) on the&#13;date of the contract modification, meaning on a catch-up basis.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;When&#13;a contract modification increases the scope of the contract as a result of adding distinct goods or services and the contract&#13;price changes by an amount reflecting the stand-alone selling prices of the additional goods or services, the Company accounts&#13;for the contract modification as a separate contract.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company generate revenue mainly from sale of products to&#13;strategic partners and distributors as well as from the licensing of our technology and distribution rights.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company identifies the goods&#13;and services it promises in its contracts with customers and analyzes whether each good or service promised is distinct. The Company&#13;further groups a series of distinct goods or services to a single performance obligation.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company&amp;#8217;s conclusion depends&#13;on the specific facts and circumstances pertaining to a contract.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;In the majority of contracts, revenue&#13;recognition occurs at a point in time when control of our product is transferred to the customer, generally on delivery of the&#13;goods.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;With regards to certain contract&#13;with our strategic partner the Company analyzed the following:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company identified few performance&#13;obligations which include:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 0.25in"&gt;a.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;Grant of a license for distribution one of the Company&amp;#8217;s products in certain territories and the&#13;supply of predetermined minimum quantities.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 0.25in"&gt;b.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;The supply of a predetermined quantity of the Company&amp;#8217;s product for the purpose of clinical trials&#13;performed conducted by strategic partner.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 0.25in"&gt;c.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;Grant of a license for the use of the Company&amp;#8217;s knowledge and patents, and the provision of consulting&#13;services with respect to the transfer of technology.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;Subsequently, the Company determines&#13;the transaction price. The transaction price is the amount of the consideration that is expected to be received based on the contract&#13;terms. The Company takes into account the effects of all the following elements when determining the transaction price&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 0.25in"&gt;a.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;Variable consideration &amp;#8211; certain amounts of the promised consideration such as milestone&#13;payments and volume rebates. The Company includes the estimated variable consideration in the transaction price only to the extent&#13;it is highly probable that a significant reversal in the amount of cumulative revenue recognized will not occur when the uncertainty&#13;is resolved.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 0.25in"&gt;b.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;Significant financing component &amp;#8211; Advance payments received provide with the benefit of financing.&#13;Accordingly the Company adjusted the transaction price for the effects of the time value of money.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 0.25in"&gt;c.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;Non-cash consideration &amp;#8211; Raw materials provided as non-cash consideration. This consideration&#13;is measured at fair value.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 0.25in"&gt;d.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;Consideration payable to customers- The Company accounts for payments made to a customer as a reduction&#13;of the revenues from the customer when the Company recognizes revenue from the transfer of goods or services to the customer or&#13;the Company pays the consideration or promises to pay the consideration in accordance with the Company&amp;#8217;s customary business&#13;practices.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company allocates the transaction&#13;price to the different performance obligation identified. This allocation is based on relative stand-alone selling price. For&#13;certain amounts of variable consideration the Company allocated to a certain performance obligation or to a distinct goods or&#13;services within it.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;For each performance obligation&#13;identified, the Company recognizes revenue when (or as) it satisfies the performance obligation. The performance obligations are&#13;satisfied over time, as the customer both simultaneously receives and consumes the benefits provided by the Company, or receives&#13;assets with no alternative use, for which the Company has an enforceable right to payment for performance completed to date. The&#13;method for measuring the progress in performance obligations that are satisfied over time usually based upon the deliverables&#13;forming part of those performance obligations.&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Deferred&#13;revenues&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Deferred&#13;revenues include unearned amounts received from customers not yet recognized as revenues.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The accounting policy for revenue recognition applied until&#13;December 31, 2017&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Revenues&#13;are recognized in profit or loss when the revenues can be measured reliably, it is probable that the economic benefits associated&#13;with the transaction will flow to the Company and the costs incurred or to be incurred in respect of the transaction can be measured&#13;reliably. In cases where the Company operates as a principal supplier and it exposed to the risks and rewards associated with&#13;the transaction, revenues are presented on a gross basis. Revenues are measured at the fair value of the consideration received&#13;less any trade discounts, volume rebates and returns.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;specific criteria for revenue recognition for the following types of revenues are:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 15.3pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Revenues&#13;                                         from the sale of goods are recognized when all the significant risks and rewards of ownership&#13;                                         of the goods have passed to the buyer and the seller no longer retains continuing managerial&#13;                                         involvement. The delivery date is usually the date on which ownership passes.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 15.3pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Agreements&#13;                                         with multiple elements provide for varying consideration terms, such as upfront payments&#13;                                         and milestone payments. Revenues from such agreements that do not contain a general right&#13;                                         of return and that are composed of multiple elements such as distribution exclusivity,&#13;                                         license and services are allocated to the different elements and are recognized in respect&#13;                                         of each element separately. An element constitutes a separate accounting unit if and&#13;                                         only if it has a separate value to the customer. Revenue from the different element is&#13;                                         recognized when the criteria for revenue recognition have been met and only to the extent&#13;                                         of the consideration that is not contingent upon completion or performance of future&#13;                                         services in the contract.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForRecognitionOfRevenue>

margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;accounting policy for leases applied effective from January 1, 2019, is as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company accounts for a contract as a lease when the contract terms convey the right to control the use of an identified asset&#13;for a period of time in exchange for consideration.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;On&#13;the inception date of the lease, the Company determines whether the arrangement is a lease or contains a lease, while examining&#13;if it conveys the right to control the use of an identified asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration. In its assessment&#13;of whether an arrangement conveys the right to control the use of an identified asset, the Company assesses whether it has the&#13;following two rights throughout the lease term:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 24.1pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;                                         right to obtain substantially all the economic benefits from use of the identified asset;&#13;                                         and&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 24.15pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;b)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;                                         right to direct the identified asset's use.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company as a lessee:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;For&#13;leases in which the Company is the lessee, the Company recognizes on the commencement date of the lease a right-of-use asset and&#13;a lease liability, excluding leases whose term is up to 12 months and leases for which the underlying asset is of low value. For&#13;these excluded leases, the Company has elected to recognize the lease payments as an expense in profit or loss on a straight-line&#13;basis over the lease term. In measuring the lease liability, the Company has elected to apply the practical expedient in the Standard&#13;and does not separate the lease components from the non-lease components (such as management and maintenance services, etc.) included&#13;in a single contract.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;On&#13;the commencement date, the lease liability includes all unpaid lease payments discounted at the interest rate implicit in the&#13;lease, if that rate can be readily determined, or otherwise using the Company's incremental borrowing rate. After the commencement&#13;date, the Company measures the lease liability using the effective interest rate method.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;On&#13;the commencement date, the right-of-use asset is recognized in an amount equal to the lease liability plus lease payments already&#13;made on or before the commencement date and initial direct costs incurred less any lease incentives received. The right-of-use&#13;asset is measured applying the cost model and depreciated over the shorter of its useful life or the lease term. The Company tests&#13;for impairment of the right-of-use asset whenever there are indications of impairment pursuant to the provisions of IAS 36.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Depreciation&#13;of right-of-use asset&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;After&#13;lease commencement, a right-of-use asset is measured on a cost basis less accumulated depreciation and accumulated impairment&#13;losses and is adjusted for re-measurements of the lease liability. Depreciation is calculated on a straight-line basis over the&#13;useful life or contractual lease period, whichever earlier, as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 4.2in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="border-bottom: black 1.5pt solid; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 51pt; text-align: center"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;%&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 10.2pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="border-bottom: black 1.5pt solid; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 56.1pt; text-align: center"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Mainly %&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top; background-color: #CCEEFF"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Land&#13;    and Buildings&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: center"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;10&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: center"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;10&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Vehicles&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: center"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;20-33&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: center"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;3&lt;/font&gt;3&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top; background-color: #CCEEFF"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;office&#13;    equipment (i.e. printing and photocopying machines)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: center"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;20&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: center"&gt;20&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Lease&#13;extension and termination options:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;A&#13;non-cancellable lease term includes both the periods covered by an option to extend the lease when it is reasonably certain that&#13;the extension option will be exercised and the periods covered by a lease termination option when it is reasonably certain that&#13;the termination option will not be exercised.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;the event of any change in the expected exercise of the lease extension option or in the expected non-exercise of the lease termination&#13;option, the Company re-measures the lease liability based on the revised lease term using a revised discount rate as of the date&#13;of the change in expectations. The total change is recognized in the carrying amount of the right-of-use asset until it is reduced&#13;to zero, and any further reductions are recognized in profit or loss.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Subleases:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;a transaction in which the Company is a lessee of an underlying asset (head lease) and the asset is subleased to a third party,&#13;the Company assesses whether the risks and rewards incidental to ownership of the right-of-use asset have been transferred to&#13;the sub-lessee, among others, by evaluating the sublease term with reference to the useful life of the right-of-use asset arising&#13;from the head lease.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;When&#13;substantially all the risks and rewards incidental to ownership of the right-of-use asset have been transferred to the sub- lessee,&#13;the Company accounts for the sublease as a finance lease, otherwise it is accounted for as an operating lease. If the sublease&#13;is classified as a finance lease, the leased asset is derecognized on the commencement date and a new asset, "finance lease&#13;receivable" is recognized at an amount equivalent to the present value of the lease payments, discounted at the interest&#13;rate implicit in the lease. Any difference between the carrying amount of the leased asset before the derecognition and the carrying&#13;amount of the finance lease receivable is recognized in profit or loss.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;Lease modification:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;If a lease modification does&#13;not reduce the scope of the lease and does not result in a separate lease, the Company re-measures the lease liability based&#13;on the modified lease terms using a revised discount rate as of the modification date and records the change in the lease&#13;liability as an adjustment to the right-of-use asset.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;If a lease modification reduces&#13;the scope of the lease, the Company recognizes a gain or loss arising from the partial or full reduction of the carrying amount&#13;of the right-of-use asset and the lease liability. The Company subsequently remeasures the carrying amount of the lease liability&#13;according to the revised lease terms, at the revised discount rate as of the modification date and records the change in the lease&#13;liability as an adjustment to the right-of-use asset.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;For&#13;additional information regarding right-of-use assets and lease liabilities and refer to Note 14.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;accounting policy for leases applied until December 31, 2018, is as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;criteria for classifying leases as finance or operating leases depend on the substance of the agreements and are made at the inception&#13;of the lease in accordance with the following principles as set out in IAS 17.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;The&#13;Company as lessee:&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Finance&#13;                                         lease&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Finance&#13;leases transfer to the Company substantially all the risks and benefits incidental to ownership of the leased asset. At the commencement&#13;of the lease term, the leased assets are measured at the fair value of the leased asset or, if lower, at the present value of&#13;the minimum lease payments.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;leased asset is depreciated over the shorter of the lease term and the expected life of the leased asset.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;2.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Operating&#13;                                         lease&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Lease&#13;agreements are classified as an operating lease if they do not transfer substantially all the risks and benefits incidental to&#13;ownership of the leased asset. Lease payments are recognized as an expense in profit or loss on a straight-line basis over the&#13;lease term.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForLeasesExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForPropertyPlantAndEquipmentExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;m.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Property,&#13;                                         plant and equipment&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;Property, plant and equipment are&#13;measured at cost, including directly attributable costs, less accumulated depreciation and any related investment grants and excluding&#13;day-to-day servicing expenses. Cost includes spare parts and auxiliary equipment that can be used only in connection with the plant&#13;and equipment.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company's assets include computer systems comprising hardware and software. Software forming an integral part of the hardware&#13;to the extent that the hardware cannot function without the software installed on it is classified as property, plant and equipment.&#13;In contrast, software that adds functionality to the hardware is classified as an intangible asset.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;cost of assets includes the cost of materials, direct labor costs, as well as any costs directly attributable to bringing the&#13;asset to the location and condition necessary for it to operate in the manner intended by management.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif;
