    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForImpairmentOfNonfinancialAssetsExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;n.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Impairment&#13;                                         of non-financial assets&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company evaluates the need to record an impairment of the carrying amount of non-financial assets whenever events or changes in&#13;circumstances indicate that the carrying amount is not recoverable. If the carrying amount of non-financial assets exceeds their&#13;recoverable amount, the assets are reduced to their recoverable amount.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;recoverable amount is the higher of fair value less costs of sale and value in use. In measuring value in use, the expected future&#13;cash flows are discounted using a pre-tax discount rate that reflects the risks specific to the asset. The recoverable amount&#13;of an asset that does not generate independent cash flows is determined for the cash-generating unit to which the asset belongs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;An&#13;impairment loss of an asset, is reversed only if there have been changes in the estimates used to determine the asset's&#13;recoverable amount since the last impairment loss was recognized. Reversal of an impairment loss, as above, shall not be&#13;increased above the lower of the carrying amount that would have been determined (net of depreciation or amortization) had no&#13;impairment loss been recognized for the asset in prior years and its recoverable amount. The reversal of impairment loss of an&#13;asset presented at cost is recognized in profit or loss.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForImpairmentOfNonfinancialAssetsExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForFinancialInstrumentsExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;o.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Financial&#13;                                         instruments&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify"&gt;On January 1, 2018, the Company initially adopted&#13;IFRS 9, "Financial Instruments" ("the Standard"). The Company elected to apply the provisions of the Standard&#13;retrospectively without restatement of comparative data.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 70.9pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify"&gt;The accounting policy for financial instruments applied&#13;commencing from January 1, 2018, is as follows:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 4.65pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;1.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Financial&#13;                                         assets&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Financial&#13;assets are classified at initial recognition, and subsequently measured at amortized cost, fair value through other comprehensive&#13;income (OCI), and fair value through profit or loss. The classification of financial assets at initial recognition depends on&#13;the financial asset's contractual cash flow characteristics and the Company's business model for managing them. With&#13;the exception of trade receivables that do not contain a significant financing component or for which the Company has applied&#13;the practical expedient, the Company initially measures a financial asset at its fair value plus, in the case of a financial asset&#13;not at fair value through profit or loss, transaction costs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;After&#13;initial recognition, the accounting treatment of financial assets is based on their classification as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Debt&#13;financial instruments are subsequently measured at fair value through profit or loss (FVPL), amortized cost, or fair value through&#13;other comprehensive income (FVOCI). The classification is based on two criteria: the Company's business model for managing&#13;the assets; and whether the instruments' contractual cash flows represent 'solely payments of principal and interest'&#13;on the principal amount outstanding (the 'SPPI criterion').&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;classification and measurement of the Company's debt financial assets are as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 18pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Debt&#13;                                         instruments at amortized cost for financial assets that are held within a business model&#13;                                         with the objective to hold the financial assets in order to collect contractual cash&#13;                                         flows that meet the SPPI criterion. This category includes the Company's Trade&#13;                                         and other receivables.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 18pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;b)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Debt&#13;                                         instruments at FVOCI, with gains or losses recycled to profit or loss on derecognition.&#13;                                         Financial assets in this category are the Company's quoted debt instruments that&#13;                                         meet the SPPI criterion and are held within a business model both to collect cash flows&#13;                                         and to sell. Interest earned whilst holding Available For Sale (AFS) financial investments&#13;                                         is reported as interest income using the effective interest rate method.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Financial&#13;assets at FVPL comprise derivative instruments unless they are designated as effective hedging instruments.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Impairment of financial&#13;assets&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company evaluates at the end of each reporting&#13;period the loss allowance for financial debt instruments which are not measured at fair value through profit or loss. The Company&#13;distinguishes between two types of loss allowances:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: left"&gt;a)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;Debt instruments whose credit risk has not increased significantly&#13;since initial recognition, or whose credit risk is low - the loss allowance recognized in respect of this debt instrument is measured&#13;at an amount equal to the expected credit losses within 12 months from the reporting date (12-month ECLs); or&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="text-align: justify; width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: justify"&gt;b)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;Debt instruments whose credit risk has increased significantly&#13;since initial recognition, and whose credit risk is not low - the loss allowance recognized is measured at an amount equal to&#13;the expected credit losses over the instrument's remaining term (lifetime ECLs).&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 106.35pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company has short-term financial assets such&#13;as trade receivables in respect of which the Company applies a simplified approach and measures the loss allowance in an amount&#13;equal to the lifetime expected credit losses.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;An impairment loss on debt instruments measured&#13;at amortized cost is recognized in profit or loss with a corresponding loss allowance that is offset from the carrying amount of&#13;the financial asset, whereas the impairment loss on debt instruments measured at fair value through other comprehensive income&#13;is recognized in profit or loss with a corresponding loss allowance that is recorded in other comprehensive income and not as a&#13;reduction of the carrying amount of the financial asset in the statement of financial position.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company applies the low credit risk simplification&#13;in the Standard, according to which the Company assumes the debt instrument's credit risk has not increased significantly since&#13;initial recognition if on the reporting date it is determined that the instrument has a low credit risk, for example when the instrument&#13;has an external rating of "investment grade".&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;In addition, the Company considers that when contractual payments&#13;in respect of a debt instrument are more than 30 days past due, there has been a significant increase in credit risk, unless there&#13;is reasonable and supportable information that demonstrates that the credit risk has not increased significantly.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company considers a financial asset in default when contractual&#13;payments are more than 90 days past due. However, in certain cases, the Company considers a financial asset to be in default when&#13;external or internal information indicates that the Company is unlikely to receive the outstanding contractual amounts in full.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company considers a financial asset that is not measured&#13;at fair value through profit or loss as credit-impaired when one or more events that have a detrimental impact on the estimated&#13;future cash flows of that financial asset have occurred. The Company takes into consideration the following events as evidence&#13;that a financial asset is credit impaired:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: left"&gt;a)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;significant financial difficulty of the issuer or borrower;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: left"&gt;b)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;a breach of contract, such as a default or past due event;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; or&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.75in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;ECLs&#13;are based on the difference between the contractual cash flows due in accordance with the contract and all the cash flows that&#13;the Company expects to receive. For other debt financial assets (i.e., debt securities at FVOCI), the ECL is based on the 12-month&#13;ECL. The 12-month ECL is the portion of lifetime ECLs that results from default events on a financial instrument that are possible&#13;within 12 months after the reporting date. As of December 31, 2019 there is no ECL allowance.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;Financial liabilities within the scope of IFRS 9 are initially&#13;measured at fair value less transaction costs that are directly attributable to the issue of the financial liability.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;After&#13;initial recognition, the accounting treatment of financial liabilities is based on their classification as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 1.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Financial&#13;                                         liabilities measured at amortized cost&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Loans,&#13;including leases, are measured based on their terms at amortized cost using the effective interest method taking into account&#13;directly attributable transaction costs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Derivatives&#13;are classified as fair value through profit and loss unless they are designated as effective hedging instruments. Transaction&#13;costs are recognized in profit or loss.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;After&#13;initial recognition, changes in fair value are recognized either in profit or loss for non-hedge accounting derivatives or in&#13;other comprehensive income for hedge accounting derivatives.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForFinancialInstrumentsExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForDerivativeFinancialInstrumentsAndHedgingExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;q&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Derivative&#13;                                         financial instruments designated as hedges&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company enters into contracts for derivative financial instruments&#13;such as forward currency contracts and cylinder strategy in respect of foreign currency to hedge risks associated with foreign&#13;exchange rates fluctuations and cash flows risk. Such derivative financial instruments are carried as financial assets when the&#13;fair value is positive and as financial liabilities when the fair value is negative.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;At&#13;the inception of a hedge relationship, the Company formally designates and documents the hedge relationship to which the Company&#13;wishes to apply hedge accounting and the risk management objective and strategy for undertaking the hedge. The hedge effectiveness&#13;is assessed at the end of each reporting period.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Any&#13;gains or losses arising from changes in the fair value of derivatives that do not qualify for hedge accounting are recorded immediately&#13;in profit or loss.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Cash&#13;flow hedges&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;effective portion of the gain or loss on the hedging instrument is recognized as other comprehensive income (loss), while any&#13;ineffective portion is recognized immediately in profit or loss.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Amounts&#13;recognized as other comprehensive income (loss) are reclassified to profit or loss when the hedged transaction affects profit&#13;or loss, such as when the hedged income or expense is recognized or when a forecast payment occurs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;If&#13;the forecast transaction or firm commitment is no longer expected to occur, amounts previously recognized in other comprehensive&#13;income are reclassified to profit or loss. If the hedging instrument expires or is sold, terminated or exercised, or if its designation&#13;as a hedge is revoked, amounts previously recognized in other comprehensive income remain in other comprehensive income until&#13;the forecast transaction or firm commitment occurs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForDerivativeFinancialInstrumentsAndHedgingExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DisclosureOfAccruedExpensesAndOtherLiabilitiesExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;r&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Provisions&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;A&#13;provision in accordance with IAS 37 is recognized when the Company has a present (legal or constructive) obligation as a result&#13;of a past event, it is expected to require the use of economic resources to clear the obligation and a reliable estimate can be&#13;made of it. The expense is recognized in the statement of profit or loss net of any reimbursement.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DisclosureOfAccruedExpensesAndOtherLiabilitiesExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForSharebasedPaymentTransactionsExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;t.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Share-based&#13;                                         payment transactions&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company's employees and Board of Directors members are entitled to remuneration in the form of equity-settled share- based&#13;payment transactions.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Equity-settled&#13;transactions&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;cost of equity-settled transactions (options and restricted shares) with employees and Board of Directors members is measured&#13;at the fair value of the equity instruments granted at grant date. The fair value of options is determined using a standard option&#13;pricing model. The fair value of restricted shares is determined using the share price at the grant date.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;cost of equity-settled transactions is recognized in profit or loss together with a corresponding increase in shareholder's&#13;equity during the period which the performance and/or service conditions are to be satisfied ending on the date on which the relevant&#13;employees become entitled to the award ("the vesting period"). The cumulative expense recognized for equity-settled&#13;transactions at the end of each reporting period until the vesting date reflects the extent to which the vesting period has expired&#13;and the Company's best estimate of the number of equity instruments that will ultimately vest.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;No&#13;expense is recognized for awards that do not ultimately vest.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;the event that the Company modifies the conditions on which equity-instruments were granted, an additional expense is calculated&#13;and recognized over the remaining vesting period for any modification that increases the total fair value of the share-based payment&#13;arrangement or is otherwise beneficial to the employee or director at the modification date.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForSharebasedPaymentTransactionsExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForEarningsPerShareExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;u.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Earnings&#13;                                         (loss) per Share&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Earnings&#13;(loss) per share are calculated by dividing the net income (loss) attributable to Company shareholders by the weighted number&#13;of ordinary shares outstanding during the period. Ordinary shares underlying shares options or restricted shares are only included&#13;in the calculation of diluted income (loss) per share when their impact dilutes the income (loss) per share. Furthermore, potential&#13;ordinary shares converted during the period are included under diluted income (loss) per share only until the conversion date,&#13;and from that date on are included under basic income (loss) per share.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForEarningsPerShareExplanatory>

Foreign exchange risks arise from recognized assets and liabilities denominated in a foreign currency other than&#13;the functional currency, such as trade and other accounts receivables, trade and other accounts payables, loans and capital leases.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; In accordance&#13;with Company policy, evaluations of the relative strength of credit of the various financial institutions are made on an ongoing&#13;basis.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 143.6pt; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 2in; text-align: justify"&gt;Short-term investments&#13;include short-term deposits with low risk for a period less than one year. The Company&amp;#8217;s marketable securities consist of&#13;investment-grade corporate bonds, government bonds (Including U.S., Israeli and other government bonds). The Company&amp;#8217;s investment&#13;policy, limits the amount the Company may invest in any one type of investment or issuer and the average maturities of the bond&#13;portfolio, thereby reducing credit risk concentrations.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 143.6pt; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 2in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company has not experienced&#13;any significant losses on its short term investments.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 1.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 0.5in"&gt;b)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;u&gt;Trade receivables:&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 2in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 2in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company regularly monitors&#13;the credit extended to its customers and their general financial condition, and, when necessary, requires collateral as security&#13;for the debt such as letters of creditor and down payments. margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify"&gt;The selected&#13;changes in the relevant risk variables were determined based on management&amp;#8217;s estimate as to reasonable possible changes in these&#13;risk variables.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 49.65pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company has performed sensitivity&#13;tests of principal market risk factors that are liable to affect its reported operating results or financial position. The sensitivity&#13;tests present the profit or loss in respect of each financial instrument for the relevant risk variable chosen for that instrument&#13;as of each reporting date. The test of risk factors was determined based on the materiality of the exposure of the operating results&#13;or financial condition of each risk with reference to the functional currency and assuming that all the other variables are constant.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif;     <ifrs-full:DisclosureOfEmployeeBenefitsExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 0.75in; text-align: left"&gt;&lt;font style="font-variant: small-caps"&gt;Note 16: -&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font-variant: small-caps"&gt;Employee&#13;                                         Benefit Liabilities, NET&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 56.7pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.7pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify"&gt;Employee&#13;benefits consist of short-term benefits and post-employment benefits.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 85.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify"&gt;Post-employment&#13;benefits:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 85.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify"&gt;According to the labor&#13;laws and Severance Pay Law in Israel, the Company is required to pay compensation to an employee upon dismissal or retirement&#13;or to make current contributions in defined contribution plans pursuant to Section 14 of the Severance Pay Law, as specified&#13;below. The Company&amp;#8217;s liability is accounted for as a post-employment benefit only for employees not under Section 14.&#13;The computation of the Company&amp;#8217;s employee benefit liability is made in accordance with a valid employment contract or a&#13;collective bargaining agreement based on the employee&amp;#8217;s salary and employment terms which establish the&#13;entitlement to receive the compensation.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 85.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify"&gt;The post-employment&#13;employee benefits are normally financed by contributions classified as defined benefit plans, as detailed below:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 85.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 0.5in; text-align: left"&gt;1.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Defined contribution deposit&lt;/u&gt;:&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 103.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company&amp;#8217;s&#13;agreements with part of its employees are in accordance with section 14 of the Israeli Severance Pay Law. Contributions made by&#13;the Company in accordance with Section&amp;#160;14 release the Company from any future severance liabilities in respect of those employees.&#13;The expenses for the defined benefit deposit in 2019, 2018 and 2017 were $1,102 thousands, $992 thousands and $884 thousands, respectively.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 103.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 0.5in; text-align: left"&gt;2.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Defined benefit plans&lt;/u&gt;:&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 85.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company&#13;accounts for the payment of compensation as a defined benefit plan for which an employee benefit liability is recognized and for&#13;which the Company deposits amounts in a long-term employee benefit fund and in qualifying insurance policies.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;3.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify"&gt;Transactions denominated in foreign&#13;currency are recorded on initial recognition at the exchange rate at the date of the transaction. After initial recognition, monetary&#13;assets and liabilities denominated in foreign currency are translated at the end of each reporting period into the functional currency&#13;at the exchange rate at that date. Exchange differences are recognized in profit or loss. Non-monetary assets and liabilities measured&#13;at cost in a foreign currency are translated at the exchange rate at the date of the transaction. Non-monetary assets and liabilities&#13;denominated in foreign currency and measured at fair value are translated into the functional currency using the exchange rate&#13;prevailing at the date when the fair value was determined.&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForForeignCurrencyTranslationExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyToDetermineComponentsOfCashAndCashEquivalents contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;e.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Cash&#13;                                         and cash equivalents&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Cash&#13;comprise of cash at banks and on hand. Cash equivalents are considered as highly liquid investments, including unrestricted short-term&#13;bank deposits with an original maturity of three months or less from the date of purchase, which are subject to an insignificant&#13;risk of changes in value.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyToDetermineComponentsOfCashAndCashEquivalents>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForInvestmentsOtherThanInvestmentsAccountedForUsingEquityMethodExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;f.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Short-term&#13;deposits&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Short-term&#13;bank deposits with a maturity of more than three months from the deposit date but less than one year and securities measured at&#13;fair value through other comprehensive income. The deposits are presented according to their terms of deposit.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForInvestmentsOtherThanInvestmentsAccountedForUsingEquityMethodExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForTradeAndOtherReceivablesExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;g.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Allowance&#13;                                         for doubtful accounts&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;allowance for doubtful accounts is determined in respect of specific debts whose collection, in the opinion of the Company's&#13;management, is doubtful. Impaired debts are derecognized when they are assessed as uncollectible. As of December 31, 2019 the&#13;Company recognized an allowance for doubtful accounts at an amount of $67 thousands.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company did not recognize an allowance in respect of groups of customers that are collectively assessed for impairment since it&#13;did not identify any groups of customers which bear similar credit risks. Impaired receivables are derecognized when they are&#13;assessed as uncollectible.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForTradeAndOtherReceivablesExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForMeasuringInventories contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;h.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Inventories&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Inventories&#13;are measured at the lower of cost and net realizable value. The cost of inventories comprises costs of purchase of raw and other&#13;materials and costs incurred in bringing the inventories to their present location and condition. Net realizable value is the&#13;estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Cost&#13;of inventories is determined as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 11pt Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; width: 20%; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Raw materials&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;At cost using the first-in, first-out method. Fair value of raw material received at no charge is not included in the inventory value.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Work in process&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Costs of raw materials, direct and indirect costs including labor, other materials and other indirect manufacturing costs allocated to the in process manufactured batches through the end of the reporting period. The allocation of indirect costs is accounted for on a quarterly basis by dividing the total quarterly indirect manufacturing cost to the batches manufactured during that quarter based on predetermined allocation factors.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Finished products&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Costs of raw materials, direct and indirect costs including labor, other materials and other indirect manufacturing costs allocated to the manufactured finished products through completion of manufacturing process.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Purchased products&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;At cost using the first-in, first-out method.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company periodically evaluates the condition and age of inventories and accounts for impairment of inventories with a lower market&#13;value or which are slow moving.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForMeasuringInventories>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForEmployeeBenefitsExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;s&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Employee&#13;                                         benefit liabilities&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company has several employee benefit plans:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;1.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Short-term&#13;                                         employee benefits&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Short-term&#13;employee benefits include salaries, paid annual leave, paid sick leave, recreation and social security contributions and are recognized&#13;as expenses as the services are rendered. A liability in respect of a cash bonus is recognized when the Company has a legal or&#13;constructive obligation to make such payment as a result of past service rendered by an employee and a reliable estimate of the&#13;amount can be made.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;2.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Post-employment&#13;                                         benefits&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;post-employment benefits plans are normally financed by contributions to insurance companies and classified as defined contribution&#13;plans or as defined benefit plans.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company has defined contribution plans pursuant to Section 14 to the Israeli Severance Pay Law under which the Company pays fixed&#13;contributions to certain employees under Section 14 and will have no legal or constructive obligation to pay further contributions.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Contributions&#13;to the defined contribution plan in respect of severance or retirement pay are recognized as an expense when contributed concurrently&#13;with performance of the employee's services.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;addition the Company operates a defined benefit plan in respect of severance pay pursuant to the Israeli Severance Pay Law. According&#13;to the Law, employees are entitled to severance pay upon dismissal or retirement. The liability for termination of employment&#13;is measured using the projected unit credit method. The actuarial assumptions include expected salary increases and rates of employee's&#13;turnover based on the estimated timing of payment. The amounts are presented based on discounted expected future cash flows using&#13;a discount rate determined by reference to market yields at the reporting date on high quality corporate bonds that are linked&#13;to the Consumer Price Index with a term that is consistent with the estimated term of the severance pay obligation.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;respect of its severance pay obligation to certain of its employees, the Company makes current deposits in pension funds and insurance&#13;companies ("the plan assets"). Plan assets comprise assets held by a long-term employee benefit fund or qualifying&#13;insurance policies. Plan assets are not available to the Company's own creditors and cannot be returned directly to the&#13;Company.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;liability for employee benefits shown in the statement of financial position reflects the present value of the defined benefit&#13;obligation less the fair value of the plan assets.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Re-measurements&#13;of the net liability are recognized in other comprehensive income in the period in which they occur.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForEmployeeBenefitsExplanatory>

    <ifrs-full:StatementOfIFRSCompliance contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;p style="font: 10pt Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: small-caps 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Note&#13;4: -&amp;#160;Disclusure of New Standards in the Period Prior to Their Adoption&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 7pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;font style="font-variant: small-caps"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.6in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Amendments&#13;to IFRS 9, IFRS 7 and IAS 39:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 7pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.6in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;September 2019, the IASB published an amendment to IFRS 9, "Financial Instruments", IFRS 7, "Financial Instruments:&#13;Disclosures" and IAS 39," Financial Instruments: Recognition and Measurement" ("the Amendment").&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 7pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.6in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;view of global regulatory changes, numerous countries have considered introducing a reform in the benchmark Interbank Offered&#13;Rates ("IBORs") (LIBOR, the London Interbank Offered Rate, being one of the most common examples) and switching to&#13;a risk-free interest rate alternative ("RFRs") which extensively rely on data of specific transactions. The IBOR reform&#13;leads to uncertainty regarding the dates and amounts to be attributed to future cash flows relating to both hedging instruments&#13;and hedged items that rely on existing IBORs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 7pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.6in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;According&#13;to the existing accounting guidance of IFRS 9 and IAS 39, entities that have entered into the above hedges are facing uncertainty&#13;as a result of the IBOR reform which is likely to affect their ability to continue meeting the effective hedging requirements&#13;underlying existing transactions as well as the hedging requirements of future transactions. In order to resolve this uncertainty,&#13;the IASB issued the Amendment to offer transitional reliefs for entities that apply IBOR-based hedge accounting. The Amendment&#13;represents phase one in the reform that will include additional amendments in the future.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 7pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.6in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Amendment also permits certain reliefs in applying the hedge accounting effectiveness tests during the period of transition from&#13;IBORs to RFRs. These reliefs assume that the benchmark interest underlying the hedge will not change as a result of the expected&#13;interest reform. The reliefs will be effective indefinitely, until the occurrence of one of the events specified in the Amendment.&#13;The Amendment also requires entities to provide specific disclosures of the application of any reliefs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 7pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.6in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Amendment is to be applied retrospectively for annual periods beginning on or after January 1, 2020. Early adoption is permitted.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 7pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.6in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company believes that the adoption of the Amendment will not have an effect on its financial statements since it does not currently&#13;enter into substantial IBOR-based hedges.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:StatementOfIFRSCompliance>
