    <ifrs-full:DisclosureOfGeneralInformationAboutFinancialStatementsExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;p style="font: 11pt Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 8pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: small-caps 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Note&#13;1: -&amp;#160;General&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;General&#13;                                         description of the Company and its activity&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;Kamada Ltd. (&amp;#8220;the Company&amp;#8221;)&#13;is a plasma-derived biopharmaceutical company focused on orphan indications, with an existing marketed product portfolio and a&#13;late-stage product pipeline. The Company uses its proprietary platform technology and know-how for the extraction and purification&#13;of proteins from human plasma to produce Alpha-1 Antitrypsin (AAT) in a highly-purified, liquid form, as well as other plasma-derived&#13;immune globulins. The Company&amp;#8217;s flagship product is Glassia&lt;sup&gt;&amp;#174;&lt;/sup&gt; (&amp;#8220;Glassia&amp;#8221;), the first liquid, ready-to-use,&#13;intravenous plasma-derived AAT product approved by the U.S. FDA. The Company markets Glassia in the U.S. through a strategic partnership&#13;with Takeda Pharmaceuticals Company Limited (&amp;#8220;Takeda&amp;#8221;) and in other counties through local distributors. The Company&amp;#8217;s&#13;second leading product is KamRab&lt;sup&gt;&amp;#174;&lt;/sup&gt;, a rabies immune globulin (Human) for post-exposure prophylaxis against rabies&#13;infection. KamRab is FDA approved and is being marketed in the U.S. under the brand name KedRab through a strategic partnership&#13;with Kedrion S.p.A (&amp;#8220;Kedrion&amp;#8221;). In addition to Glassia and KedRab, the Company has a product line of four other plasma-derived&#13;pharmaceutical products administered by injection or infusion, that are marketed through distributors in more than 15 countries,&#13;including Israel, Russia, Brazil, India and other countries in Latin America and Asia. The Company has late-stage products in development,&#13;including an inhaled formulation of AAT for the treatment of AAT deficiency. In addition, the Company&amp;#8217;s intravenous AAT is&#13;in development for other indications, such as GvHD and prevention of lung transplant rejection. The Company leverages its expertise&#13;and presence in the plasma-derived protein therapeutics market by distributing more than 20 complementary products in Israel that&#13;are manufactured by third parties.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;Pursuant to the agreement with&#13;Takeda (as detailed on Note 17) the Company will continue to produce Glassia for Takeda through 2021. Takeda is planning to complete&#13;the technology transfer of Glassia, and pending FDA approval, will initiate its own production of Glassia for the U.S. market in&#13;2021. Accordingly, following the transition of manufacturing to Takeda, the Company will terminate the manufacturing and sale of&#13;Glassia to Takeda resulting in a significant reduction in revenues. Pursuant to the agreement, upon initiation of sales of Glassia&#13;manufactured by Takeda, Takeda will pay royalties to the Company at a rate of 12% on net sales through August 2025, and at a rate&#13;of 6% thereafter until 2040, with a minimum of $5 million annually, for each of the years from 2022 to 2040.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif;                                         Standards ("IFRS") as issued by the International Accounting Standard Board.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Measurement&#13;                                         basis:&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company's consolidated&#13;Financial Statements are prepared on a cost basis, except for financial instruments (including derivatives) at fair value through&#13;profit or loss and other comprehensive income such as marketable securities financial assets.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company has elected to present profit or loss items using the "function of expense" method.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;                                         Company's operating cycle is one year.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;c.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;                                         consolidated financial statements comprise the financial statements of companies that&#13;                                         are controlled by the Company (subsidiaries). Control is achieved when the Company is&#13;                                         exposed, or has rights, to variable returns from its involvement with the investee and&#13;                                         has the ability to affect those returns through its power over the investee. The consolidation&#13;                                         of the financial statements commences on the date on which control is obtained and ends&#13;                                         when such control ceases.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;financial statements of the Company and of the subsidiaries are prepared as of the same dates and periods. The consolidated financial&#13;statements are prepared using uniform accounting policies by all companies in the Group. Significant intercompany balances and&#13;transactions, gains or losses resulting from intercompany transactions are eliminated in full in the consolidated financial statements.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;d.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Functional&#13;                                         currency, presentation currency and foreign currency&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 4.65pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;1.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Functional&#13;                                         currency and presentation currency&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;consolidated financial statements are presented in U.S. dollars, which is the Company's functional and presentation currency.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;2.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Transactions,&#13;                                         assets and liabilities in foreign currency&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify"&gt;Transactions denominated in foreign&#13;currency are recorded on initial recognition at the exchange rate at the date of the transaction. After initial recognition, monetary&#13;assets and liabilities denominated in foreign currency are translated at the end of each reporting period into the functional currency&#13;at the exchange rate at that date. Exchange differences are recognized in profit or loss. Non-monetary assets and liabilities measured&#13;at cost in a foreign currency are translated at the exchange rate at the date of the transaction. Non-monetary assets and liabilities&#13;denominated in foreign currency and measured at fair value are translated into the functional currency using the exchange rate&#13;prevailing at the date when the fair value was determined.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;e.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Cash&#13;                                         and cash equivalents&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Cash&#13;comprise of cash at banks and on hand. Cash equivalents are considered as highly liquid investments, including unrestricted short-term&#13;bank deposits with an original maturity of three months or less from the date of purchase, which are subject to an insignificant&#13;risk of changes in value.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;f.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Short-term&#13;deposits&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Short-term&#13;bank deposits with a maturity of more than three months from the deposit date but less than one year and securities measured at&#13;fair value through other comprehensive income. The deposits are presented according to their terms of deposit.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;g.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Allowance&#13;                                         for doubtful accounts&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;allowance for doubtful accounts is determined in respect of specific debts whose collection, in the opinion of the Company's&#13;management, is doubtful. Impaired debts are derecognized when they are assessed as uncollectible. As of December 31, 2019 the&#13;Company recognized an allowance for doubtful accounts at an amount of $67 thousands.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company did not recognize an allowance in respect of groups of customers that are collectively assessed for impairment since it&#13;did not identify any groups of customers which bear similar credit risks. Impaired receivables are derecognized when they are&#13;assessed as uncollectible.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;h.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Inventories&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Inventories&#13;are measured at the lower of cost and net realizable value. The cost of inventories comprises costs of purchase of raw and other&#13;materials and costs incurred in bringing the inventories to their present location and condition. Net realizable value is the&#13;estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Cost&#13;of inventories is determined as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 11pt Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; width: 20%; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Raw materials&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;At cost using the first-in, first-out method. Fair value of raw material received at no charge is not included in the inventory value.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Work in process&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Costs of raw materials, direct and indirect costs including labor, other materials and other indirect manufacturing costs allocated to the in process manufactured batches through the end of the reporting period. The allocation of indirect costs is accounted for on a quarterly basis by dividing the total quarterly indirect manufacturing cost to the batches manufactured during that quarter based on predetermined allocation factors.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Finished products&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Costs of raw materials, direct and indirect costs including labor, other materials and other indirect manufacturing costs allocated to the manufactured finished products through completion of manufacturing process.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Purchased products&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="padding-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;At cost using the first-in, first-out method.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company periodically evaluates the condition and age of inventories and accounts for impairment of inventories with a lower market&#13;value or which are slow moving.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.45pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;i.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Research&#13;                                         and development costs &lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Research&#13;expenditures are recognized in profit or loss when incurred and include preclinical and clinical costs (as well as cost of materials&#13;associated with the development of new products or existing products for new therapeutic indications). In addition, these costs&#13;include additional product development activities with respect to approved and distributed products as well as post marketing&#13;commitment research and development activities.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;An&#13;intangible asset arising from a development project or from the development phase of an internal project is recognized if the&#13;Company can demonstrate the technical feasibility of completing the intangible asset so that it will be available for use or sale;&#13;the Company's intention to complete the intangible asset and use or sell it; the Company's ability to use or sell&#13;the intangible asset; how the intangible asset will generate future economic benefits; the availability of adequate technical,&#13;financial and other resources to complete the intangible asset; and the Company's ability to measure reliably the expenditure&#13;attributable to the intangible asset during its development. Since the Company development projects are often subject to regulatory&#13;approval procedures and other uncertainties, the conditions for the capitalization of costs incurred before receipt of approvals&#13;are not normally satisfied and therefore, development expenditures are recognized in profit or loss when incurred.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;j.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Revenue&#13;                                         recognition&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;On&#13;January 1, 2018, the Company initially adopted IFRS 15, "Revenue from Contracts with Customers" ("the Standard").&#13;The Company elected to apply the provisions of the Standard using the modified retrospective method with the application of certain&#13;practical expedients and without restatement of comparative data. The accounting policy for revenue recognition applied from January&#13;1, 2018, is as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company recognizes revenue&#13;when the customer obtains control over the promised goods or services. Revenues are recognized at an amount that reflects the&#13;consideration to which an entity expects to be entitled in exchange for transferring goods or services to a customer. The Company&#13;includes variable consideration, such as milestone payments or volume rebates, in the transaction price only when it is highly&#13;probable that its inclusion will not result in a significant revenue reversal in the future when the uncertainty has been subsequently&#13;resolved&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;determining the amount of revenue from contracts with customers, the Company evaluates whether it is a principal or an agent in&#13;the arrangement. The Company is a principal when the Company controls the promised goods or services before transferring them&#13;to the customer. In these circumstances, the Company recognizes revenue for the gross amount of the consideration.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Identifying&#13;the contract&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company account for a contract with a customer only when all of the following criteria are met:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif;                                         with other customary business practices) and are committed to perform their respective&#13;                                         obligations;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif;
