                                        (including the extension option held by the Company and intended to be exercised) and&#13;                                         the expected life of the improvement.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;useful life, depreciation method and residual value of an asset are reviewed at the year-end and any changes are accounted for&#13;prospectively as a change in accounting estimate.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Depreciation&#13;of an asset ceases at the earlier of the date that the asset is classified as held for sale and the date that the asset is derecognized.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;n.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Impairment&#13;                                         of non-financial assets&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company evaluates the need to record an impairment of the carrying amount of non-financial assets whenever events or changes in&#13;circumstances indicate that the carrying amount is not recoverable. If the carrying amount of non-financial assets exceeds their&#13;recoverable amount, the assets are reduced to their recoverable amount.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;recoverable amount is the higher of fair value less costs of sale and value in use. In measuring value in use, the expected future&#13;cash flows are discounted using a pre-tax discount rate that reflects the risks specific to the asset. The recoverable amount&#13;of an asset that does not generate independent cash flows is determined for the cash-generating unit to which the asset belongs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;An&#13;impairment loss of an asset, is reversed only if there have been changes in the estimates used to determine the asset's&#13;recoverable amount since the last impairment loss was recognized. Reversal of an impairment loss, as above, shall not be&#13;increased above the lower of the carrying amount that would have been determined (net of depreciation or amortization) had no&#13;impairment loss been recognized for the asset in prior years and its recoverable amount. The reversal of impairment loss of an&#13;asset presented at cost is recognized in profit or loss.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;o.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Financial&#13;                                         instruments&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify"&gt;On January 1, 2018, the Company initially adopted&#13;IFRS 9, "Financial Instruments" ("the Standard"). The Company elected to apply the provisions of the Standard&#13;retrospectively without restatement of comparative data.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 70.9pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify"&gt;The accounting policy for financial instruments applied&#13;commencing from January 1, 2018, is as follows:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 4.65pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;1.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Financial&#13;                                         assets&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Financial&#13;assets are classified at initial recognition, and subsequently measured at amortized cost, fair value through other comprehensive&#13;income (OCI), and fair value through profit or loss. The classification of financial assets at initial recognition depends on&#13;the financial asset's contractual cash flow characteristics and the Company's business model for managing them. With&#13;the exception of trade receivables that do not contain a significant financing component or for which the Company has applied&#13;the practical expedient, the Company initially measures a financial asset at its fair value plus, in the case of a financial asset&#13;not at fair value through profit or loss, transaction costs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;After&#13;initial recognition, the accounting treatment of financial assets is based on their classification as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Debt&#13;financial instruments are subsequently measured at fair value through profit or loss (FVPL), amortized cost, or fair value&#13;through other comprehensive income (FVOCI). The classification is based on two criteria: the Company's business model&#13;for managing the assets; and whether the instruments' contractual cash flows represent 'solely payments of&#13;principal and interest' on the principal amount outstanding (the 'SPPI criterion').&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;classification and measurement of the Company's debt financial assets are as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 18pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Debt&#13;                                         instruments at amortized cost for financial assets that are held within a business model&#13;                                         with the objective to hold the financial assets in order to collect contractual cash&#13;                                         flows that meet the SPPI criterion. This category includes the Company's Trade&#13;                                         and other receivables.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 18pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;b)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Debt&#13;                                         instruments at FVOCI, with gains or losses recycled to profit or loss on derecognition.&#13;                                         Financial assets in this category are the Company's quoted debt instruments that&#13;                                         meet the SPPI criterion and are held within a business model both to collect cash flows&#13;                                         and to sell. Interest earned whilst holding Available For Sale (AFS) financial investments&#13;                                         is reported as interest income using the effective interest rate method.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Financial&#13;assets at FVPL comprise derivative instruments unless they are designated as effective hedging instruments.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Impairment of financial&#13;assets&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company evaluates at the end of each reporting&#13;period the loss allowance for financial debt instruments which are not measured at fair value through profit or loss. The Company&#13;distinguishes between two types of loss allowances:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: left"&gt;a)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;Debt instruments whose credit risk has not increased significantly&#13;since initial recognition, or whose credit risk is low - the loss allowance recognized in respect of this debt instrument is measured&#13;at an amount equal to the expected credit losses within 12 months from the reporting date (12-month ECLs); or&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="text-align: justify; width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: justify"&gt;b)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;Debt instruments whose credit risk has increased significantly&#13;since initial recognition, and whose credit risk is not low - the loss allowance recognized is measured at an amount equal to&#13;the expected credit losses over the instrument's remaining term (lifetime ECLs).&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 106.35pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company has short-term financial assets such&#13;as trade receivables in respect of which the Company applies a simplified approach and measures the loss allowance in an amount&#13;equal to the lifetime expected credit losses.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;An impairment loss on debt instruments measured&#13;at amortized cost is recognized in profit or loss with a corresponding loss allowance that is offset from the carrying amount of&#13;the financial asset, whereas the impairment loss on debt instruments measured at fair value through other comprehensive income&#13;is recognized in profit or loss with a corresponding loss allowance that is recorded in other comprehensive income and not as a&#13;reduction of the carrying amount of the financial asset in the statement of financial position.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company applies the low credit risk simplification&#13;in the Standard, according to which the Company assumes the debt instrument's credit risk has not increased significantly since&#13;initial recognition if on the reporting date it is determined that the instrument has a low credit risk, for example when the instrument&#13;has an external rating of "investment grade".&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;In addition, the Company considers that when contractual payments&#13;in respect of a debt instrument are more than 30 days past due, there has been a significant increase in credit risk, unless there&#13;is reasonable and supportable information that demonstrates that the credit risk has not increased significantly.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company considers a financial asset in default when contractual&#13;payments are more than 90 days past due. However, in certain cases, the Company considers a financial asset to be in default when&#13;external or internal information indicates that the Company is unlikely to receive the outstanding contractual amounts in full.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company considers a financial asset that is not measured&#13;at fair value through profit or loss as credit-impaired when one or more events that have a detrimental impact on the estimated&#13;future cash flows of that financial asset have occurred. The Company takes into consideration the following events as evidence&#13;that a financial asset is credit impaired:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: left"&gt;a)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;significant financial difficulty of the issuer or borrower;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.75in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: left"&gt;b)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;a breach of contract, such as a default or past due event;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.75in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: left"&gt;c)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;a concession granted to the borrower due to the borrower's&#13;financial difficulties that would otherwise not be granted;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.75in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: left"&gt;d)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;it is probable that the borrower will enter bankruptcy&#13;or financial reorganization;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.75in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: left"&gt;e)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;the disappearance of an active market for that financial&#13;asset because of financial difficulties; or&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.75in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 112.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 18pt; text-align: left"&gt;f)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;the purchase or origination of a financial asset at a deep&#13;discount that reflects the incurred credit losses.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 106.35pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;ECLs&#13;are based on the difference between the contractual cash flows due in accordance with the contract and all the cash flows that&#13;the Company expects to receive. For other debt financial assets (i.e., debt securities at FVOCI), the ECL is based on the 12-month&#13;ECL. The 12-month ECL is the portion of lifetime ECLs that results from default events on a financial instrument that are possible&#13;within 12 months after the reporting date. As of December 31, 2019 there is no ECL allowance.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;2.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Financial&#13;                                         liabilities&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;Financial liabilities within the scope of IFRS 9 are initially&#13;measured at fair value less transaction costs that are directly attributable to the issue of the financial liability.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;After&#13;initial recognition, the accounting treatment of financial liabilities is based on their classification as follows:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Financial&#13;                                         liabilities measured at amortized cost&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Loans,&#13;including leases, are measured based on their terms at amortized cost using the effective interest method taking into account&#13;directly attributable transaction costs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;b)&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Financial&#13;                                         liabilities measured at fair value&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Derivatives&#13;are classified as fair value through profit and loss unless they are designated as effective hedging instruments. Transaction&#13;costs are recognized in profit or loss.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;After&#13;initial recognition, changes in fair value are recognized either in profit or loss for non-hedge accounting derivatives or in&#13;other comprehensive income for hedge accounting derivatives.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="width: 0.5in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="width: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;p.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font-size: 10pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Fair value measurement&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Fair&#13;value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market&#13;participants at the measurement date.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Fair&#13;value measurement is based on the assumption that the transaction will take place in the asset's or the liability's&#13;principal market, or in the absence of a principal market, in the most advantageous market.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using the assumptions that market participants would use when pricing the asset&#13;or liability, assuming that market participants act in their economic best interest.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;Fair value measurement&#13;of a non-financial asset takes into account a market participant's ability to generate economic benefits by using the asset&#13;in its highest and best use or by selling it to another market participant that would use the asset in its highest and best use.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in the circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to measure&#13;fair value, maximizing the use of relevant observable inputs and minimizing the use of unobservable inputs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;All&#13;assets and liabilities for which fair value is measured or disclosed in the financial statements are categorized within the fair&#13;value hierarchy, described as follows, based on the lowest level input that is significant to the fair value measurement as a&#13;whole:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 15.3pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Level&#13;                                         1 - quoted prices (unadjusted) in active markets for identical assets or liabilities.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Level&#13;                                         2 - inputs other than quoted prices included within Level 1 that are observable either&#13;                                         directly or indirectly.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Level&#13;                                         3 - inputs that are not based on observable market data (valuation techniques which use&#13;                                         inputs that are not based on observable market data).&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Offsetting&#13;                                         financial instruments&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Financial&#13;assets and financial liabilities are offset and the net amount is presented in the statement of financial position if there is&#13;a legally enforceable right to set off the recognized amounts and there is an intention either to settle on a net basis or to&#13;realize the asset and settle the liability simultaneously.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;right of set-off must be legally enforceable not only during the ordinary course of business of the parties to the contract but&#13;also in the event of bankruptcy or insolvency of one of the parties. In order for the right of set-off to be currently available,&#13;it must not be contingent on a future event, there may not be periods during which the right is not available, or there may not&#13;be any events that will cause the right to expire.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Financial&#13;                                         assets&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 2in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Financial&#13;assets are derecognized when the contractual rights to the cash flows from the financial asset expire or the Company has transferred&#13;its contractual rights to receive cash flows from the financial asset or assumes an obligation to pay the cash flows in full without&#13;material delay to a third party and has transferred substantially all the risks and rewards of the asset, or has neither transferred&#13;nor retained substantially all the risks and rewards of the asset, but has transferred control of the asset.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Financial&#13;                                         liabilities&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;A&#13;financial liability is derecognized when it is extinguished, that is when the obligation is discharged or cancelled or expires.&#13;A financial liability is extinguished when the debtor (the Company) discharges the liability by paying in cash, other financial&#13;assets, goods or services or is legally released from the liability.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Derivative&#13;                                         financial instruments designated as hedges&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Company enters into contracts for derivative financial instruments&#13;such as forward currency contracts and cylinder strategy in respect of foreign currency to hedge risks associated with foreign&#13;exchange rates fluctuations and cash flows risk. Such derivative financial instruments are carried as financial assets when the&#13;fair value is positive and as financial liabilities when the fair value is negative.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;At&#13;the inception of a hedge relationship, the Company formally designates and documents the hedge relationship to which the Company&#13;wishes to apply hedge accounting and the risk management objective and strategy for undertaking the hedge. The hedge effectiveness&#13;is assessed at the end of each reporting period.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Any&#13;gains or losses arising from changes in the fair value of derivatives that do not qualify for hedge accounting are recorded immediately&#13;in profit or loss.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;effective portion of the gain or loss on the hedging instrument is recognized as other comprehensive income (loss), while any&#13;ineffective portion is recognized immediately in profit or loss.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Amounts&#13;recognized as other comprehensive income (loss) are reclassified to profit or loss when the hedged transaction affects profit&#13;or loss, such as when the hedged income or expense is recognized or when a forecast payment occurs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;If&#13;the forecast transaction or firm commitment is no longer expected to occur, amounts previously recognized in other comprehensive&#13;income are reclassified to profit or loss. If the hedging instrument expires or is sold, terminated or exercised, or if its designation&#13;as a hedge is revoked, amounts previously recognized in other comprehensive income remain in other comprehensive income until&#13;the forecast transaction or firm commitment occurs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;r&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Provisions&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;A&#13;provision in accordance with IAS 37 is recognized when the Company has a present (legal or constructive) obligation as a result&#13;of a past event, it is expected to require the use of economic resources to clear the obligation and a reliable estimate can be&#13;made of it. The expense is recognized in the statement of profit or loss net of any reimbursement.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; A liability in respect of a cash bonus is recognized when the Company has a legal or&#13;constructive obligation to make such payment as a result of past service rendered by an employee and a reliable estimate of the&#13;amount can be made.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;2.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Post-employment&#13;                                         benefits&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;post-employment benefits plans are normally financed by contributions to insurance companies and classified as defined contribution&#13;plans or as defined benefit plans.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company has defined contribution plans pursuant to Section 14 to the Israeli Severance Pay Law under which the Company pays fixed&#13;contributions to certain employees under Section 14 and will have no legal or constructive obligation to pay further contributions.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Contributions&#13;to the defined contribution plan in respect of severance or retirement pay are recognized as an expense when contributed concurrently&#13;with performance of the employee's services.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;addition the Company operates a defined benefit plan in respect of severance pay pursuant to the Israeli Severance Pay Law. According&#13;to the Law, employees are entitled to severance pay upon dismissal or retirement. The liability for termination of employment&#13;is measured using the projected unit credit method. The actuarial assumptions include expected salary increases and rates of employee's&#13;turnover based on the estimated timing of payment. The amounts are presented based on discounted expected future cash flows using&#13;a discount rate determined by reference to market yields at the reporting date on high quality corporate bonds that are linked&#13;to the Consumer Price Index with a term that is consistent with the estimated term of the severance pay obligation.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;respect of its severance pay obligation to certain of its employees, the Company makes current deposits in pension funds and insurance&#13;companies ("the plan assets"). Plan assets comprise assets held by a long-term employee benefit fund or qualifying&#13;insurance policies. Plan assets are not available to the Company's own creditors and cannot be returned directly to the&#13;Company.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;liability for employee benefits shown in the statement of financial position reflects the present value of the defined benefit&#13;obligation less the fair value of the plan assets.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Re-measurements&#13;of the net liability are recognized in other comprehensive income in the period in which they occur.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;t.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Share-based&#13;                                         payment transactions&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company's employees and Board of Directors members are entitled to remuneration in the form of equity-settled share- based&#13;payment transactions.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Equity-settled&#13;transactions&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;cost of equity-settled transactions (options and restricted shares) with employees and Board of Directors members is measured&#13;at the fair value of the equity instruments granted at grant date. The fair value of options is determined using a standard option&#13;pricing model. The fair value of restricted shares is determined using the share price at the grant date.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;cost of equity-settled transactions is recognized in profit or loss together with a corresponding increase in shareholder's&#13;equity during the period which the performance and/or service conditions are to be satisfied ending on the date on which the relevant&#13;employees become entitled to the award ("the vesting period"). The cumulative expense recognized for equity-settled&#13;transactions at the end of each reporting period until the vesting date reflects the extent to which the vesting period has expired&#13;and the Company's best estimate of the number of equity instruments that will ultimately vest.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;No&#13;expense is recognized for awards that do not ultimately vest.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;In&#13;the event that the Company modifies the conditions on which equity-instruments were granted, an additional expense is calculated&#13;and recognized over the remaining vesting period for any modification that increases the total fair value of the share-based payment&#13;arrangement or is otherwise beneficial to the employee or director at the modification date.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;u.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Earnings&#13;                                         (loss) per Share&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Earnings&#13;(loss) per share are calculated by dividing the net income (loss) attributable to Company shareholders by the weighted number&#13;of ordinary shares outstanding during the period. Ordinary shares underlying shares options or restricted shares are only included&#13;in the calculation of diluted income (loss) per share when their impact dilutes the income (loss) per share. Furthermore, potential&#13;ordinary shares converted during the period are included under diluted income (loss) per share only until the conversion date,&#13;and from that date on are included under basic income (loss) per share.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;v&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Reclassification&#13;                                         of prior years' amounts&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Certain&#13;amounts in prior years' financial statements have been reclassified to conform to the current year's presentation.&#13;The reclassification had no effect on previously reported net loss or shareholders' equity.&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 42.55pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 28pt"&gt;w.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font-size: 10pt"&gt;Changes in accounting policies - initial application of new financial&#13;reporting and accounting standards and amendments to existing financial reporting and accounting standards:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 113.4pt; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 113.4pt; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 70.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;u&gt;Initial application of IFRS 16, "Leases"&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;In January 2016, the IASB issued IFRS 16, "Leases"&#13;("the Standard"), which provides guidance on the recognition, measurement, presentation and disclosure of leases and&#13;supersedes IAS 17, "Leases" ("the old Standard"), IFRIC 4, "Determining Whether an Arrangement Contains&#13;a Lease", and SIC-15, "Operating Leases - Incentives". According to the Standard, a lease is a contract, or part&#13;of a contract, that conveys the right to use an asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Standard has been applied for the first time in&#13;these financial statements. As permitted by the Standard, the Company elected to apply the provisions of the Standard using the&#13;modified retrospective method. The Company recognized lease liabilities on the initial application date of the Standard in respect&#13;of leases previously classified as operating leases according to IAS 17. The amount of the liability as of the date of initial&#13;application of the Standard was measured using the Company's incremental borrowing rate of interest on the date of initial application&#13;of the Standard.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;Certain right-of-use assets were measured as if the&#13;Standard has been applied from the commencement date of the lease but for the purpose of calculation, the lessee's incremental&#13;borrowing rate on the date of initial adoption was used, while the carrying amount of other right-of-use assets are identical to&#13;the carrying amount of the lease liability. For details of the accounting policy applied from the date of initial application of&#13;the Standard, see Note 14b.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The main effect of the initial application of the&#13;Standard relates to existing leases in which the Company is the lessee. According to the Standard, as explained in Note 14b, the&#13;Company recognizes a lease liability and a corresponding right-of-use asset for each lease in which it is the lessee, excluding&#13;certain exceptions. This accounting treatment is different than the accounting treatment applied under the old Standard according&#13;to which the lease payments in respect of leases for which substantially all the risks and rewards incidental to ownership of the&#13;leased asset were not transferred to the lessee were recognized as an expense in profit or loss on a straight-line basis over the&#13;lease term.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;Following are data relating to the initial application&#13;of the Standard as of January 1, 2019, in respect of leases existing as of that date:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif;
