    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForIncomeTaxExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;k.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Taxes&#13;                                         on income&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Taxes&#13;on income in profit or loss comprise of current and deferred taxes. Current or deferred taxes are recognized in profit or loss,&#13;except to the extent that the tax arises from items which are recognized directly in other comprehensive income or equity.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;1.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Current&#13;                                         taxes:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;current tax liability is measured using the tax rates and tax laws that have been enacted or substantively enacted by the end&#13;of reporting period as well as adjustments required in connection with the tax liability in respect of previous years.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;2.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Deferred&#13;                                         taxes:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Deferred&#13;taxes are computed in respect of carryforward losses and temporary differences between the carrying amounts in the financial statements&#13;and the amounts attributed for tax purposes.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Deferred&#13;taxes are measured at the tax rates that are expected to apply when the asset is realized or the liability is settled, based on&#13;tax laws that have been enacted or substantively enacted by the end of the reporting period.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Deferred&#13;tax assets are reviewed at the end of each reporting period and reduced to the extent that it is not probable that they will be&#13;utilized. Deductible carryforward losses and temporary differences for which deferred tax assets had not been recognized are reviewed&#13;at the end of each reporting period and a respective deferred tax asset is recognized to the extent that their utilization is&#13;probable.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Deferred&#13;taxes are offset in the statement of financial position if there is a legally enforceable right to offset a current tax asset&#13;against a current tax liability and the deferred taxes relate to the same taxpayer and the same taxation authority.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;3.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;IFRIC&#13;                                         23, "Uncertainty over Income Tax Treatments":&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify"&gt;In June 2017, the IASB issued&#13;IFRIC 23, "Uncertainty over Income Tax Treatments" ("the Interpretation"). The Interpretation clarifies&#13;the accounting for recognition and measurement of assets or liabilities in accordance with the provisions of IAS 12, "Income&#13;Taxes", in situations of uncertainty involving income taxes. The Interpretation provides guidance on (i) considering whether&#13;some tax treatments should be considered collectively, (ii) measurement of the effects of uncertainty involving income taxes on&#13;the financial statements and (iii) accounting for changes in facts and circumstances in respect of the uncertainty.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;As&#13;of December 31, 2019 and 2018, the application of IFRIC 23 did not have a material effect on the financial statements.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForIncomeTaxExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForFairValueMeasurementExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="width: 0.5in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="width: 0.5in; font-size: 10pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;p.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="font-size: 10pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Fair value measurement&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Fair&#13;value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market&#13;participants at the measurement date.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Fair&#13;value measurement is based on the assumption that the transaction will take place in the asset's or the liability's&#13;principal market, or in the absence of a principal market, in the most advantageous market.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using the assumptions that market participants would use when pricing the asset&#13;or liability, assuming that market participants act in their economic best interest.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;Fair value measurement&#13;of a non-financial asset takes into account a market participant's ability to generate economic benefits by using the asset&#13;in its highest and best use or by selling it to another market participant that would use the asset in its highest and best use.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;Company uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in the circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to measure&#13;fair value, maximizing the use of relevant observable inputs and minimizing the use of unobservable inputs.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;All&#13;assets and liabilities for which fair value is measured or disclosed in the financial statements are categorized within the fair&#13;value hierarchy, described as follows, based on the lowest level input that is significant to the fair value measurement as a&#13;whole:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 15.3pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Level&#13;                                         1 - quoted prices (unadjusted) in active markets for identical assets or liabilities.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 15.3pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Level&#13;                                         2 - inputs other than quoted prices included within Level 1 that are observable either&#13;                                         directly or indirectly.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 15.3pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Level&#13;                                         3 - inputs that are not based on observable market data (valuation techniques which use&#13;                                         inputs that are not based on observable market data).&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;1&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Offsetting&#13;                                         financial instruments&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Financial&#13;assets and financial liabilities are offset and the net amount is presented in the statement of financial position if there is&#13;a legally enforceable right to set off the recognized amounts and there is an intention either to settle on a net basis or to&#13;realize the asset and settle the liability simultaneously.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;The&#13;right of set-off must be legally enforceable not only during the ordinary course of business of the parties to the contract but&#13;also in the event of bankruptcy or insolvency of one of the parties. In order for the right of set-off to be currently available,&#13;it must not be contingent on a future event, there may not be periods during which the right is not available, or there may not&#13;be any events that will cause the right to expire.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;2&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;De-recognition&#13;                                         of financial instruments&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 4.65pt; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Financial&#13;                                         assets&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 2in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;Financial&#13;assets are derecognized when the contractual rights to the cash flows from the financial asset expire or the Company has transferred&#13;its contractual rights to receive cash flows from the financial asset or assumes an obligation to pay the cash flows in full without&#13;material delay to a third party and has transferred substantially all the risks and rewards of the asset, or has neither transferred&#13;nor retained substantially all the risks and rewards of the asset, but has transferred control of the asset.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&lt;tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1.5in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;b.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Financial&#13;                                         liabilities&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 2in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;A&#13;financial liability is derecognized when it is extinguished, that is when the obligation is discharged or cancelled or expires.&#13;A financial liability is extinguished when the debtor (the Company) discharges the liability by paying in cash, other financial&#13;assets, goods or services or is legally released from the liability.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForFairValueMeasurementExplanatory>

    <ifrs-full:DisclosureOfCommitmentsAndContingentLiabilitiesExplanatory contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 0.75in; text-align: left"&gt;&lt;font style="font-variant: small-caps"&gt;Note 17: -&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font-variant: small-caps"&gt;Contingent&#13;                                         Liabilities and Commitments&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 85.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 85.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="width: 72px"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="width: 48px; font-size: 10pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;a.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;    &lt;td style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"&gt;On August 23, 2010, the Company entered into a 30 years collaboration agreement with Baxter Healthcare Corporation (&amp;#8220;Baxter&amp;#8221;) with respect to obtaining the distribution rights for Glassia. During 2015, Baxter assigned all its rights under the collaboration agreement to Baxalta US Inc. (&amp;#8220;Baxalta&amp;#8221;) which was acquired during 2016 by Shire plc (&amp;#8220;Shire&amp;#8221;), which is now part of Takeda (&amp;#8220;Takeda&amp;#8221; and in these consolidated financial statements Baxter, Baxalta and Shire will be referred to as &amp;#8220;Takeda&amp;#8221;).&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"&gt;The&#13;collaboration agreement consists of three main agreements (1) An Exclusive Manufacturing, Supply and Distribution agreement for&#13;Glassia in the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand (the &amp;#8220;Territory&amp;#8221; and the &amp;#8220;Distribution Agreement&amp;#8221;,&#13;respectively); (2) Technology License Agreement for the use of the Company&amp;#8217;s knowhow and patents for the production, continued&#13;development and sale of Glassia by Takeda (the &amp;#8220;License Agreement&amp;#8221;) in the Territory; and (3) A Paste Supply Agreement&#13;for the supply by Takeda of plasma derived fraction IV-1 to be used by the Company for the production of Glassia (the &amp;#8220;Raw&#13;Materials Supply Agreement&amp;#8221;).&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;Pursuant to the agreements,&#13;the Company was entitled to certain upfront and milestone payments at a total amount of $45 million, and for a minimum commitment&#13;of Takeda to acquire Glassia produced by the Company over the first five years of the term of the Distribution Agreement. In addition,&#13;upon initiation of sales of Glassia manufactured by Takeda the Company will be entitled to royalty payments at a rate of 12% on&#13;net sales of Glassia through August 2025, and at a rate of 6% thereafter until 2040, with a minimum of $5 million annually (the&#13;&amp;#8220;Royalty Payments&amp;#8221;).&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;As of December 31, 2019, the&#13;Company received a total of $39.5 million on account of the agreed upfront and milestone payments from Takeda pursuant to the Distribution&#13;and License Agreements as amended. Prior to the October 2016 amendment of the Distribution Agreement, the net proceeds on account&#13;of the upfront the milestone payments received were recorded as deferred revenues and were recognized as revenues based on the&#13;actual sales of Glassia on a pro-rata basis. Following October 2016, the balance of the deferred revenues was recognized on a straight&#13;- line basis according to Takeda&amp;#8217;s updated minimum purchase commitment through December 31, 2018, which was the term of the&#13;supply commitment period prior to the October 2016 amendment. Non- refundable revenues due to the achievement of milestones are&#13;recognized upon reaching the milestone. The Company is entitled to the remaining unpaid balance of the millstone payments totaling&#13;$5.5 million which will be paid upon the achievement of such milestones.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;Between 2013 and 2019, the parties&#13;amended the License Agreement and the Distribution Agreement to extend the supply of Glassia by the Company to Takeda and increase&#13;Takeda&amp;#8217;s minimum purchase commitment. Pursuant to the recent amendment of the Distribution Agreement entered into during&#13;August 2019, the maximum commitment by the Company to manufacture and sale Glassia to Takeda and the minimum commitment of Takeda&#13;to acquire Glassia manufactured by the Company is currently extended through the end of 2021. The Company projects that total revenues&#13;from sales of Glassia to Takeda for the year 2020 will be approximately $65 million and for the year 2021 between $25 million to&#13;$50 million. See note 22a for information regarding 2019 revenues from sales to Takeda.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;Takeda is planning to complete&#13;the technology transfer of Glassia, and pending FDA approval, will initiate, during 2021 its own production of Glassia for distribution&#13;in the U.S. market. Accordingly, following the transition of manufacturing to Takeda, the Company will terminate the manufacturing&#13;and sale of Glassia to Takeda resulting in a significant reduction in revenues. Upon initiation of sales of Glassia manufactured&#13;by Takeda, Takeda will pay the Company the Royalty Payments as defined above.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;Pursuant to the Distribution&#13;Agreement, Takeda is responsible to conduct any required additional clinical studies required to obtain or maintain Glassia&amp;#8217;s&#13;marketing authorization in the Territory. Under certain condition, the Company will be required to participate in the funding of&#13;these clinical studies in a total amount not to exceed $10 million.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 85.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 70.9pt; text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;Pursuant to the Raw Material&#13;Supply Agreement Takeda undertook to provide the Company, free of charge, all quantities of plasma derived fraction IV-1 required&#13;by the Company for manufacturing Glassia to be sold to Takeda for distribution in the Territory. The Company accounts for the fair&#13;value of the plasma derived fraction IV-1 used and sold as revenues and charges the same fair value to cost of revenue. In addition,&#13;the Company has the right to acquire from Takeda plasma derived fraction IV-1 for its continued development and for the production,&#13;sale and distribution of Glassia by the Company outside the Territory.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 0.75in"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding-right: 0; width: 0.5in"&gt;b.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 0"&gt;In November 2006, the Company entered into an agreement with PARI GmbH in&#13;connection with a supply by the third party of a certain medical devise required for the development of a Company&amp;#8217;s Inhaled&#13;AAT product. Pursuant to the agreement, the Company was licensed to use developments made by the third party. Furthermore, the&#13;third party will provide the Company certain quantities of devices for carrying out clinical trials, free of charge. In the event&#13;that the development is successful and the underlining product obtains required marketing authorization, the Company will pay the&#13;third party royalties based on sales of the devices through the later of the device patents expiration period or 15 years from&#13;the first commercial sale of the Company&amp;#8217;s the Inhaled AAT product.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;On expiration of the royalty&#13;period, the license will become non-exclusive and the Company shall be entitled to use the rights granted to it pursuant to the&#13;agreement without paying royalties or any other compensation. In addition, and according to a mechanism set in the agreement, the&#13;third party would be required to pay royalties to the Company of the total net sales of the device exceeding a certain amount,&#13;through the later of the device patents expiration period or 15 years from the first commercial sale of the Company&amp;#8217;s Inhaled&#13;AAT product.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;In February 2008, the parties&#13;executed an amendment to the agreement according to which the exclusive global license granted to the Company was expanded to two&#13;additional indications. The royalties are applicable to all indications mentioned above.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;In addition, the parties&#13;entered into a commercialization and supply agreement, which ensures long-term regular supply of the device, including spare parts.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 82.4pt; text-align: justify"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in; text-align: justify"&gt;In May 2019, the Company&#13;signed a Clinical Study Supply Agreement (&amp;#8220;CSSA&amp;#8221;) with such third party for the supply of the required quantities of&#13;controller kits and the web portal associated with the third party&amp;#8217;s device required for Company&amp;#8217;s continued clinical&#13;trials with respect the its Inhaled AAT product.     <kmda:InitialApplicationOfNewFinancialReportingAndAccountingStandardsPolicy contextRef="From2019-01-01to2019-12-31">&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&lt;td style="width: 42.55pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="width: 28pt"&gt;w.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="text-align: justify"&gt;&lt;font style="font-size: 10pt"&gt;Changes in accounting policies - initial application of new financial&#13;reporting and accounting standards and amendments to existing financial reporting and accounting standards:&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 113.4pt; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 113.4pt; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"&gt;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 70.5pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;u&gt;Initial application of IFRS 16, &amp;#8220;Leases&amp;#8221;&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;In January 2016, the IASB issued IFRS 16, &amp;#8220;Leases&amp;#8221;&#13;(&amp;#8220;the Standard&amp;#8221;), which provides guidance on the recognition, measurement, presentation and disclosure of leases and&#13;supersedes IAS 17, &amp;#8220;Leases&amp;#8221; (&amp;#8220;the old Standard&amp;#8221;), IFRIC 4, &amp;#8220;Determining Whether an Arrangement Contains&#13;a Lease&amp;#8221;, and SIC-15, &amp;#8220;Operating Leases - Incentives&amp;#8221;. According to the Standard, a lease is a contract, or part&#13;of a contract, that conveys the right to use an asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The Standard has been applied for the first time in&#13;these financial statements. As permitted by the Standard, the Company elected to apply the provisions of the Standard using the&#13;modified retrospective method. The Company recognized lease liabilities on the initial application date of the Standard in respect&#13;of leases previously classified as operating leases according to IAS 17. The amount of the liability as of the date of initial&#13;application of the Standard was measured using the Company&amp;#8217;s incremental borrowing rate of interest on the date of initial application&#13;of the Standard.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.25in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;Certain right-of-use assets were measured as if the&#13;Standard has been applied from the commencement date of the lease but for the purpose of calculation, the lessee&amp;#8217;s incremental&#13;borrowing rate on the date of initial adoption was used, while the carrying amount of other right-of-use assets are identical to&#13;the carrying amount of the lease liability. For details of the accounting policy applied from the date of initial application of&#13;the Standard, see Note 14b.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in"&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;The main effect of the initial application of the&#13;Standard relates to existing leases in which the Company is the lessee. According to the Standard, as explained in Note 14b, the&#13;Company recognizes a lease liability and a corresponding right-of-use asset for each lease in which it is the lessee, excluding&#13;certain exceptions. This accounting treatment is different than the accounting treatment applied under the old Standard according&#13;to which the lease payments in respect of leases for which substantially all the risks and rewards incidental to ownership of the&#13;leased asset were not transferred to the lessee were recognized as an expense in profit or loss on a straight-line basis over the&#13;lease term.&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"&gt;Following are data relating to the initial application&#13;of the Standard as of January 1, 2019, in respect of leases existing as of that date:&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 113.55pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/p&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: bottom"&gt;&#13; <td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ifrs-full_DescriptionOfOtherAccountingPoliciesRelevantToUnderstandingOfFinancialStatements', window );">Basis of presentation of financial statements</a></td>
<td class="text"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">a.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><u>Basis
                                         of presentation of financial statements</u></font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 4.65pt; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">1.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">These
                                         financial statements have been prepared in accordance with International Financial Reporting
                                         Standards ("IFRS") as issued by the International Accounting Standard Board.</font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><u>Measurement
                                         basis:</u></font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">The Company's consolidated
Financial Statements are prepared on a cost basis, except for financial instruments (including derivatives) at fair value through
profit or loss and other comprehensive income such as marketable securities financial assets.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
Company has elected to present profit or loss items using the "function of expense" method.</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">b.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
                                         Company's operating cycle is one year.</font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">c.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
                                         consolidated financial statements comprise the financial statements of companies that
                                         are controlled by the Company (subsidiaries). Control is achieved when the Company is
                                         exposed, or has rights, to variable returns from its involvement with the investee and
                                         has the ability to affect those returns through its power over the investee. The consolidation
                                         of the financial statements commences on the date on which control is obtained and ends
                                         when such control ceases.</font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
financial statements of the Company and of the subsidiaries are prepared as of the same dates and periods. The consolidated financial
statements are prepared using uniform accounting policies by all companies in the Group. Significant intercompany balances and
transactions, gains or losses resulting from intercompany transactions are eliminated in full in the consolidated financial statements.</font></p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ifrs-full_DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForForeignCurrencyTranslationExplanatory', window );">Functional currency, presentation currency and foreign currency</a></td>
<td class="text"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">d.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><u>Functional
                                         currency, presentation currency and foreign currency</u></font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 4.65pt; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">1.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><u>Functional
                                         currency and presentation currency</u></font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
consolidated financial statements are presented in U.S. dollars, which is the Company's functional and presentation currency.</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 1in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><u>Transactions,
                                         assets and liabilities in foreign currency</u></font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1.5in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">Transactions denominated in foreign
currency are recorded on initial recognition at the exchange rate at the date of the transaction. After initial recognition, monetary
assets and liabilities denominated in foreign currency are translated at the end of each reporting period into the functional currency
at the exchange rate at that date. Exchange differences are recognized in profit or loss. Non-monetary assets and liabilities measured
at cost in a foreign currency are translated at the exchange rate at the date of the transaction. Non-monetary assets and liabilities
denominated in foreign currency and measured at fair value are translated into the functional currency using the exchange rate
prevailing at the date when the fair value was determined.</p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ifrs-full_DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyToDetermineComponentsOfCashAndCashEquivalents', window );">Cash and cash equivalents</a></td>
<td class="text"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">e.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><u>Cash
                                         and cash equivalents</u></font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Cash
comprise of cash at banks and on hand. Cash equivalents are considered as highly liquid investments, including unrestricted short-term
bank deposits with an original maturity of three months or less from the date of purchase, which are subject to an insignificant
risk of changes in value.</font></p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ifrs-full_DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForInvestmentsOtherThanInvestmentsAccountedForUsingEquityMethodExplanatory', window );">Short-term investments</a></td>
<td class="text"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">f.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><u>Short-term
deposits</u></font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Short-term
bank deposits with a maturity of more than three months from the deposit date but less than one year and securities measured at
fair value through other comprehensive income. The deposits are presented according to their terms of deposit.</font></p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ifrs-full_DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForTradeAndOtherReceivablesExplanatory', window );">Allowance for doubtful accounts</a></td>
<td class="text"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">g.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><u>Allowance
                                         for doubtful accounts</u></font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
allowance for doubtful accounts is determined in respect of specific debts whose collection, in the opinion of the Company's
management, is doubtful. Impaired debts are derecognized when they are assessed as uncollectible. As of December 31, 2019 the
Company recognized an allowance for doubtful accounts at an amount of $67 thousands.</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
Company did not recognize an allowance in respect of groups of customers that are collectively assessed for impairment since it
did not identify any groups of customers which bear similar credit risks. Impaired receivables are derecognized when they are
assessed as uncollectible.</font></p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ifrs-full_DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForMeasuringInventories', window );">Inventories</a></td>
<td class="text"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">h.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><u>Inventories</u></font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Inventories
are measured at the lower of cost and net realizable value. The cost of inventories comprises costs of purchase of raw and other
materials and costs incurred in bringing the inventories to their present location and condition. Net realizable value is the
estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business.</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Cost
of inventories is determined as follows:</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></font></p>

<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 11pt Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
<tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0; width: 1in">&#160;</td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0; width: 20%; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Raw materials</font></td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">At cost using the first-in, first-out method. Fair value of raw material received at no charge is not included in the inventory value.</font></td></tr>
<tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0">&#160;</td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0">&#160;</td></tr>
<tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0">&#160;</td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Work in process</font></td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Costs of raw materials, direct and indirect costs including labor, other materials and other indirect manufacturing costs allocated to the in process manufactured batches through the end of the reporting period. The allocation of indirect costs is accounted for on a quarterly basis by dividing the total quarterly indirect manufacturing cost to the batches manufactured during that quarter based on predetermined allocation factors.</font></td></tr>
<tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0">&#160;</td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0">&#160;</td></tr>
<tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0">&#160;</td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Finished products</font></td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Costs of raw materials, direct and indirect costs including labor, other materials and other indirect manufacturing costs allocated to the manufactured finished products through completion of manufacturing process.</font></td></tr>
<tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0">&#160;</td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</td></tr>
<tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0">&#160;</td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Purchased products</font></td>
    <td style="padding-bottom: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">At cost using the first-in, first-out method.</font></td></tr>
</table>


<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
Company periodically evaluates the condition and age of inventories and accounts for impairment of inventories with a lower market
value or which are slow moving.</font></p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ifrs-full_DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseExplanatory', window );">Research and development costs</a></td>
<td class="text"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.45pt; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">i.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><u>Research
                                         and development costs </u></font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Research
expenditures are recognized in profit or loss when incurred and include preclinical and clinical costs (as well as cost of materials
associated with the development of new products or existing products for new therapeutic indications). In addition, these costs
include additional product development activities with respect to approved and distributed products as well as post marketing
commitment research and development activities.</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">An
intangible asset arising from a development project or from the development phase of an internal project is recognized if the
Company can demonstrate the technical feasibility of completing the intangible asset so that it will be available for use or sale;
the Company's intention to complete the intangible asset and use or sell it; the Company's ability to use or sell
the intangible asset; how the intangible asset will generate future economic benefits; the availability of adequate technical,
financial and other resources to complete the intangible asset; and the Company's ability to measure reliably the expenditure
attributable to the intangible asset during its development. Since the Company development projects are often subject to regulatory
approval procedures and other uncertainties, the conditions for the capitalization of costs incurred before receipt of approvals
are not normally satisfied and therefore, development expenditures are recognized in profit or loss when incurred.</font></p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ifrs-full_DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForRecognitionOfRevenue', window );">Revenue recognition</a></td>
<td class="text"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top"><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; padding: 0; width: 0.5in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">j.</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><u>Revenue
                                         recognition</u></font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">On
January 1, 2018, the Company initially adopted IFRS 15, &#8220;Revenue from Contracts with Customers&#8221; (&#8220;the Standard&#8221;).
The Company elected to apply the provisions of the Standard using the modified retrospective method with the application of certain
practical expedients and without restatement of comparative data. The accounting policy for revenue recognition applied from January
1, 2018, is as follows:</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify">The Company recognizes revenue
when the customer obtains control over the promised goods or services. Revenues are recognized at an amount that reflects the
consideration to which an entity expects to be entitled in exchange for transferring goods or services to a customer. The Company
includes variable consideration, such as milestone payments or volume rebates, in the transaction price only when it is highly
probable that its inclusion will not result in a significant revenue reversal in the future when the uncertainty has been subsequently
resolved</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">In
determining the amount of revenue from contracts with customers, the Company evaluates whether it is a principal or an agent in
the arrangement. The Company is a principal when the Company controls the promised goods or services before transferring them
to the customer. In these circumstances, the Company recognizes revenue for the gross amount of the consideration.</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Identifying
the contract</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><b>&#160;</b></font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
Company account for a contract with a customer only when all of the following criteria are met:</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">a)</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
                                         parties to the contract have approved the contract (in writing, orally or in accordance
                                         with other customary business practices) and are committed to perform their respective
                                         obligations;</font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">b)</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
                                         Company can identify each party&#8217;s rights regarding the goods or services to be
                                         transferred;</font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">c)</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
                                         Company can identify the payment terms for the goods or services to be transferred;</font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">d)</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
                                         contract has commercial substance (i.e. the risk, timing or amount of the entity&#8217;s
                                         future cash flows is expected to change as a result of the contract); and</font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 1in"></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">e)</font></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0; text-align: justify"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">It
                                         is probable that the Company will collect the consideration to which it will be entitled
                                         in exchange for the goods or services that will be transferred to the customer</font></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">For
the purpose of paragraph (e) the Company examines, inter alia, the percentage of the advance payments received and the spread
of the contractual payments, past experience with the customer and the status and existence of sufficient collateral.</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Combination
of contracts</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><b>&#160;</b></font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
Company accounts for multiple contracts as a single contract when all the contracts are signed at or near the same time with the
same customer or with related parties of the customer, and when one of the following criteria is met:</font></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</font></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
